test_cases.title: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Start of Mission durumuna geçiş yapmaya hazırdır ve RBC ile iletişim kurabilecek konumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission komutu.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC simülatörü veya test ortamı, Start of Mission tetikleyicisi için gerekli yanıtı verebilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU'ya Start of Mission tetikleyicisi uygulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile bir iletişim oturumu başlatır.

steps.action: OBU'nun iletişim durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Oturum aktif olarak raporlanır ve RBC ile veri alışverişi başlar.

test_cases.title: Ray kenarı komutu ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ray kenarı altyapısı ile iletişim halindedir ve mevcut bir oturum yoktur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ray kenarından gelen oturum başlatma komutu.
test_cases.assumptions: Ray kenarı simülatörü, oturum başlatma komutunu gönderebilmektedir.

steps.action: Ray kenarından OBU'ya oturum başlatma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, komutu alır ve RBC ile iletişim oturumu başlatır.

steps.action: OBU'nun iletişim durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Oturum aktif olarak raporlanır.

test_cases.title: RBC'ye raporlanacak mod değişikliği ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC'ye raporlanması gereken bir mod değişikliği yapmaya hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mod değişikliği tetikleyicisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Mod değişikliği, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4'te tanımlanan tetikleyicilerden biridir.

steps.action: OBU'da RBC'ye raporlanacak bir mod değişikliği yapılır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu başlatır.

steps.action: OBU'nun iletişim durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Oturum aktif olarak raporlanır ve mod değişikliği RBC'ye iletilir.

test_cases.title: Manuel Level 2 seviye değişikliği ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2 seviyesine manuel olarak geçiş yapmaya hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Manuel Level 2 seviye değişikliği komutu.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzü, manuel seviye değişikliği komutunu gönderebilmektedir.

steps.action: Sürücü, OBU'da manuel olarak Level 2 seviye değişikliği yapar.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu başlatır.

steps.action: OBU'nun iletişim durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Oturum aktif olarak raporlanır.

test_cases.title: Duyurulmuş radyo deliğinin sonuna ulaşma ile iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, duyurulmuş bir radyo deliğinin içinde seyahat etmektedir ve motorun arka ucu deliğin sonuna yaklaşmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Motorun arka ucunun radyo deliğinin sonuna ulaşması.
test_cases.assumptions: Radyo deliği konumu ve boyutu OBU tarafından bilinmektedir.

steps.action: Motorun arka ucu, duyurulmuş radyo deliğinin sonuna ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu başlatır.

steps.action: OBU'nun iletişim durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Oturum aktif olarak raporlanır.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kaybı sonrası oturumun sona ermesi ile yeni oturum başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile aktif bir iletişim oturumuna sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kaybı.
test_cases.assumptions: Radyo bağlantısı simüle edilebilir şekilde kesilebilmektedir.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kesilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mevcut oturumu sona erdirir.

steps.action: OBU'nun iletişim durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile yeni bir iletişim oturumu başlatır.

test_cases.title: Start of Mission dışında sürücünün manuel RBC iletişim bilgisi seçimi ile oturum başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Start of Mission durumu dışında bir durumdadır ve sürücü RBC iletişim bilgisi seçebilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sürücünün manuel RBC iletişim bilgisi seçimi.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzü, RBC iletişim bilgisi seçimini desteklemektedir.

steps.action: Sürücü, Start of Mission dışında OBU'da manuel olarak RBC iletişim bilgisi seçer.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu başlatır.

steps.action: OBU'nun iletişim durumu gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Oturum aktif olarak raporlanır.

test_cases.title: Başarılı iletişim oturumu kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim kurabilecek durumda ve Start of Mission modunda değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Uyumluluğu olan sistem versiyonu içeren RBC yanıtı.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC, OBU'nun gönderdiği 'Initiation of communication session' mesajına uyumlu bir sistem versiyonu ile yanıt verir.

steps.action: OBU'ya iletişim oturumu kurma komutu verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'request safe radio connection set-up' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den bağlantı onayı beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den uyumlu sistem versiyonu içeren yanıt alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder ve 'session established report' mesajını gönderir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kurulumundaki ilk hatanın tekrarlanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim kurabilecek durumda ve Start of Mission modunda değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: İlk denemede başarısız olan, ikinci denemede başarılı olan RBC yanıtı.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC, ilk 'request safe radio connection set-up' mesajına yanıt vermez veya hata döndürür, ikincisinde başarılı olur.

steps.action: OBU'ya iletişim oturumu kurma komutu verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'request safe radio connection set-up' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den ilk denemede hata/yanıt gelmez.
steps.expected: OBU, 'request safe radio connection set-up' mesajını hemen tekrar gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den ikinci denemede bağlantı onayı alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.

test_cases.title: Uyumsuz sistem versiyonu durumunda oturumun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim kurabilecek durumda ve Start of Mission modunda değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: OBU ile uyumlu olmayan sistem versiyonu içeren RBC yanıtı.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC, OBU'nun desteklemediği bir sistem versiyonu numarası döndürür.

steps.action: OBU'ya iletişim oturumu kurma komutu verilir ve bağlantı kurulur.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den uyumsuz sistem versiyonu içeren yanıt alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, 'No compatible version supported' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzü gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Sürücüye uyumsuzluk hatası bildirilir.

steps.action: OBU'nun iletişim durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılmıştır.

test_cases.title: Start of Mission sırasında sınırlı tekrar denemeleri
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Start of Mission modundadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı kurulumu için gerekli olan maksimum deneme sayısını aşan başarısızlık senaryosu.
test_cases.assumptions: Appendix A.3.1'de Start of Mission için tanımlı maksimum deneme sayısı 3'tür (örnek amaçlı).

steps.action: OBU'ya Start of Mission sırasında iletişim oturumu kurma komutu verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'request safe radio connection set-up' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den yanıt gelmez (1. başarısızlık).
steps.expected: OBU, mesajı tekrar gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den yanıt gelmez (2. başarısızlık).
steps.expected: OBU, mesajı tekrar gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den yanıt gelmez (3. başarısızlık).
steps.expected: OBU, Appendix A.3.1 sınırlaması nedeniyle tekrar denemeyi durdurur ve hata durumuna geçer.

test_cases.title: Trackside order priority over driver choice
test_cases.preconditions: Both radio systems (GSM-R and FRMCS) are fitted and active. The target RBC is configured as FRMCS-only. The driver has selected GSM-R at Start of Mission.
test_cases.test_inputs: Target RBC: FRMCS-only. Driver Selection: GSM-R. Stored Preference: GSM-R.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU receives a valid trackside order indicating the target RBC is FRMCS-only.

steps.action: Initiate the safe radio connection set-up request towards the target RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU selects the FRMCS radio system for the connection request, ignoring the driver's GSM-R selection.

test_cases.title: Driver choice priority over stored preference
test_cases.preconditions: Both radio systems (GSM-R and FRMCS) are fitted and active. The target RBC is not FRMCS-only (no specific trackside order forcing FRMCS). The driver has selected FRMCS at Start of Mission. The stored Radio Network information prefers GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: Target RBC: Standard (not FRMCS-only). Driver Selection: FRMCS. Stored Preference: GSM-R.
test_cases.assumptions: No trackside order overrides the selection.

steps.action: Initiate the safe radio connection set-up request towards the target RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU selects the FRMCS radio system for the connection request, overriding the stored GSM-R preference.

test_cases.title: Stored preference used when no driver choice or trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: Both radio systems (GSM-R and FRMCS) are fitted and active. The target RBC is not FRMCS-only. The driver has not made a single-radio choice at Start of Mission (or choice is neutral/undefined). The stored Radio Network information prefers GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: Target RBC: Standard. Driver Selection: None/Neutral. Stored Preference: GSM-R.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'driver's single-radio choice' is considered absent or non-prioritized in this scenario.

steps.action: Initiate the safe radio connection set-up request towards the target RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU selects the GSM-R radio system for the connection request, based on the stored Radio Network information.

test_cases.title: Trackside order for GSM-R target RBC
test_cases.preconditions: Both radio systems (GSM-R and FRMCS) are fitted and active. The target RBC is configured to require GSM-R (trackside order indicates GSM-R). The driver has selected FRMCS at Start of Mission.
test_cases.test_inputs: Target RBC: GSM-R required. Driver Selection: FRMCS. Stored Preference: FRMCS.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside order explicitly indicates the target RBC is not FRMCS-only, implying GSM-R usage or allowing GSM-R priority if specified by order.

steps.action: Initiate the safe radio connection set-up request towards the target RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU selects the GSM-R radio system for the connection request, following the trackside order priority.

test_cases.title: Memorization of successful radio system after session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is equipped with both radio systems (e.g., GSM-R and LTE-R). The OBU is in a state where it can establish a communication session.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to establish a communication session using Radio System A.
test_cases.assumptions: Radio System A is configured and available. The OBU has a mechanism to query or observe the memorized radio system status.

steps.action: Initiate a communication session using Radio System A.
steps.expected: The OBU successfully establishes a safe radio connection via Radio System A.

steps.action: Query the OBU's status or internal state regarding the memorized radio system.
steps.expected: The OBU reports that Radio System A is the memorized system used for the last successful safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Memorization update when switching to a different radio system
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is equipped with both radio systems. The OBU currently has Radio System A memorized from a previous successful session.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to establish a new communication session using Radio System B.
test_cases.assumptions: Radio System B is configured and available. The OBU allows switching between radio systems for session establishment.

steps.action: Initiate a new communication session using Radio System B.
steps.expected: The OBU successfully establishes a safe radio connection via Radio System B.

steps.action: Query the OBU's status or internal state regarding the memorized radio system.
steps.expected: The OBU reports that Radio System B is the memorized system, overwriting the previous memorization of Radio System A.

test_cases.title: Memorization retention after failed session attempt on different system
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is equipped with both radio systems. The OBU currently has Radio System A memorized from a previous successful session. Radio System B is unavailable or configured to fail.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to establish a communication session using Radio System B.
test_cases.assumptions: Radio System B is forced to fail (e.g., by disabling the interface or simulating a network error) to ensure the session establishment is unsuccessful.

steps.action: Initiate a communication session using Radio System B.
steps.expected: The OBU fails to establish a safe radio connection via Radio System B.

steps.action: Query the OBU's status or internal state regarding the memorized radio system.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to report Radio System A as the memorized system, as the last successful connection was via A.

test_cases.title: Abort session on desk closure during Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where a communication session can be initiated. The safe radio connection is not yet established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to initiate Start of Mission; Command to close the driver's desk.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows simulating the 'desk closure' condition defined in SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.8.

steps.action: Initiate the process to establish a communication session (e.g., send the first request to set up the safe radio connection).
steps.expected: The OBU begins the session establishment process. The safe radio connection is in the process of being set up but is not yet fully established (system version not yet received).

steps.action: Trigger the 'desk closure' condition while the session is still being established.
steps.expected: The OBU aborts the ongoing communication session.

steps.action: Check the status of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The safe radio connection is released.

test_cases.title: Abort session on End of Mission during establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where a communication session can be initiated. The safe radio connection is not yet established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to initiate communication session; Command to execute End of Mission.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows simulating the 'End of Mission' condition defined in SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.8.

steps.action: Initiate the process to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU begins the session establishment process.

steps.action: Trigger the 'End of Mission' condition while the session is still being established.
steps.expected: The OBU aborts the ongoing communication session.

steps.action: Check the status of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The safe radio connection is released.

test_cases.title: Abort session on trackside termination order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where a communication session can be initiated. The safe radio connection is not yet established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to initiate communication session; Trackside termination order message.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows simulating a 'trackside termination order' condition defined in SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.8.

steps.action: Initiate the process to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU begins the session establishment process.

steps.action: Receive a trackside termination order while the session is still being established.
steps.expected: The OBU aborts the ongoing communication session.

steps.action: Check the status of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The safe radio connection is released.

test_cases.title: Abort session when min safe rear end passes Level 2 exit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where a communication session can be initiated. The safe radio connection is not yet established. The train is approaching a Level 2 exit.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to initiate communication session; Position data indicating the minimum safe rear end has passed the Level 2 exit.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows simulating the position of the minimum safe rear end relative to the Level 2 exit.

steps.action: Initiate the process to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU begins the session establishment process.

steps.action: Update the train position such that the minimum safe rear end passes the Level 2 exit while the session is still being established.
steps.expected: The OBU aborts the ongoing communication session.

steps.action: Check the status of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The safe radio connection is released.

test_cases.title: Abort session when min safe rear end passes RBC/RBC border
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where a communication session can be initiated. The safe radio connection is not yet established. The train is approaching an RBC/RBC border.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to initiate communication session; Position data indicating the minimum safe rear end has passed the RBC/RBC border.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows simulating the position of the minimum safe rear end relative to the RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Initiate the process to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU begins the session establishment process.

steps.action: Update the train position such that the minimum safe rear end passes the RBC/RBC border while the session is still being established.
steps.expected: The OBU aborts the ongoing communication session.

steps.action: Check the status of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The safe radio connection is released.

test_cases.title: OBU uses stored RBC contact info when 'last known RBC' identity is received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where it can accept trackside orders. The OBU has valid stored RBC contact information (e.g., IP address or phone number) for a specific RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish communication session with RBC identity set to 'last known RBC' and a telephone number different from the stored one.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'last known RBC' identity value is a specific, defined constant in the ETCS protocol. The stored RBC contact information is distinct from the telephone number provided in the test order.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a communication session with the RBC. Set the RBC identity field to the special value meaning 'last known RBC'. Set the telephone number field to a value different from the OBU's stored RBC contact information.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the order and processes it.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's communication attempt to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates a communication session using the stored RBC contact information, not the telephone number provided in the order.

test_cases.title: OBU behavior when 'last known RBC' identity is received but no stored contact info exists
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where it can accept trackside orders. The OBU has no stored RBC contact information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish communication session with RBC identity set to 'last known RBC' and a valid telephone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'if any' for stored contact info. The behavior when no stored info exists is not explicitly defined in the requirement text, but the OBU must not use the provided telephone number. It should likely fail to establish the session or report an error.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a communication session with the RBC. Set the RBC identity field to the special value meaning 'last known RBC'. Set the telephone number field to a valid, reachable number.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the order and processes it.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's communication attempt to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not use the telephone number provided in the order. Since no stored RBC contact information exists, the OBU fails to establish the communication session or reports an error indicating missing contact information.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores trackside order to establish session with last known RBC when no contact info is stored
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where it can receive trackside messages. No RBC contact information is stored in the OBU's memory.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside message containing an order to establish a communication session with the last known RBC (using the special RBC identity value).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to verify the presence of stored RBC contact information before processing the session establishment order.

steps.action: Ensure the OBU has no stored RBC contact information.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates no RBC contact information is available.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to the OBU to establish a communication session with the last known RBC using the special RBC identity value.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the trackside order.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's response to the trackside order.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order and does not attempt to establish a communication session with any RBC.

test_cases.title: Ongoing session establishment prevents new session initiation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-1 is currently being established (e.g., after Start of Mission).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-1 (e.g., manual selection of RBC contact information).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows manual selection of RBC contact information while a session is being established for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate the establishment of a communication session with RBC-1 via Start of Mission.
steps.expected: The OBU begins the session establishment process with RBC-1.

steps.action: While the session with RBC-1 is still being established, trigger a new session request with the same RBC-1 (e.g., via manual selection).
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-1. The existing establishment process continues or the new request is ignored.

test_cases.title: Established session without termination prevents new session initiation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-1 is established and active. No 'Termination of Communication Session' message has been sent to RBC-1.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-1 (e.g., order from trackside).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can receive an order from trackside to initiate a session while an existing session is active.

steps.action: Verify that a communication session with RBC-1 is established and active.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates an active session with RBC-1.

steps.action: Trigger a new session request with the same RBC-1 (e.g., via an order from trackside).
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-1. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: New session allowed after Termination of Communication Session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-1 is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-1 (e.g., manual level change to Level 2).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can send a 'Termination of Communication Session' message to RBC-1.

steps.action: Send a 'Termination of Communication Session' message to RBC-1.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-1 is terminated.

steps.action: Trigger a new session request with RBC-1 (e.g., via manual level change to Level 2).
steps.expected: The OBU opens a new communication session with RBC-1.

test_cases.title: Session initiation with different RBC while session with another RBC is active
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-1 is established and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-2 (e.g., manual selection of RBC-2 contact information).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports communication with multiple RBCs and allows manual selection of different RBCs.

steps.action: Verify that a communication session with RBC-1 is established and active.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates an active session with RBC-1.

test_cases.title: MA request parameter persistence and immediate update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in MA mode and has received initial MA request parameters from RBC (e.g., repetition period = 10s, trigger criteria set).
test_cases.test_inputs: Initial MA parameters: Repetition Period = 10s. New MA parameters: Repetition Period = 5s.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC can send new MA request parameters at any time. OBU logs MA request timestamps.

steps.action: Wait for the first MA request to be sent based on initial parameters (10s period).
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request at t=10s.

steps.action: At t=12s, RBC sends new MA request parameters with a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: OBU receives and stores the new parameters. The old parameters are replaced.

steps.action: Monitor OBU behavior for the next MA request.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request immediately (at t=12s) because the time since the last MA request (12s - 10s = 2s) is less than the new repetition period (5s)? No, wait. The requirement says: 'if at the moment new parameters are received the time since the last MA request is equal to or higher than the newly received repetition period, the OBU shall send an MA request immediately'. In this case, time since last request is 2s. New period is 5s. 2s < 5s. So it should NOT send immediately. It should wait until t=17s (12s + 5s). Let's adjust the test to cover the 'immediate' case in a separate test or adjust this one to verify the 'wait' case first, or better, create a specific test for the immediate case. Let's make this test verify the replacement and the standard timing logic where immediate send is NOT triggered.

steps.action: Wait until t=17s (12s + 5s).
steps.expected: OBU sends the next MA request at t=17s, adhering to the new 5s repetition period.

test_cases.title: Immediate MA request upon receiving new parameters when time elapsed >= new period

test_cases.test_inputs: New MA parameters: Repetition Period = 5s. New parameters received at t=6s.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC sends new parameters at t=6s.

steps.action: At t=6s, RBC sends new MA request parameters with a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: OBU receives the new parameters.

steps.action: Check OBU behavior immediately after receiving new parameters.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request immediately at t=6s, because the time since the last MA request (6s - 0s = 6s) is greater than or equal to the new repetition period (5s).

steps.action: Wait for the next MA request.
steps.expected: OBU sends the next MA request at t=11s (6s + 5s).

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Time elapsed exactly equal to new repetition period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in MA mode. Last MA request was sent at t=0s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA parameters: Repetition Period = 5s. New parameters received at t=5s.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC sends new parameters at t=5s.

steps.action: At t=5s, RBC sends new MA request parameters with a repetition period of 5s.
steps.expected: OBU receives the new parameters.

steps.action: Check OBU behavior immediately after receiving new parameters.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request immediately at t=5s, because the time since the last MA request (5s - 0s = 5s) is equal to the new repetition period (5s).

test_cases.title: No immediate MA request when time elapsed is less than new repetition period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in MA mode. Last MA request was sent at t=0s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA parameters: Repetition Period = 10s. New parameters received at t=4s.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC sends new parameters at t=4s.

steps.action: Wait until t=14s (4s + 10s).

test_cases.title: OBU does not terminate session without trackside order or defined condition

test_cases.title: OBU initiates session termination when a defined termination condition is fulfilled

test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger a termination condition defined in SUBSET-026 (e.g., loss of communication integrity or specific timeout).

steps.action: Establish a valid communication session between the OBU and the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates an active session.

steps.action: Simulate a termination condition defined in SUBSET-026 (e.g., stop sending keep-alive messages to trigger a timeout).
steps.expected: The OBU detects the fulfillment of the termination condition.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU state after the condition is met.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session without an explicit trackside order.

test_cases.title: Termination of Communication Session mesajının zaman aşımında tekrarlanması

test_cases.title: Onay alındığında tekrarın durdurulması

test_cases.title: Sürekli onay alınamadığında tekrarların devam etmesi

test_cases.title: Communication session termination after max retries and timeout
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it is sending 'Termination of Communication Session' messages. The 'defined number of times' from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1 is known (assumed to be N). The 'fixed waiting time' is known (assumed to be T).
test_cases.test_inputs: N (max retries), T (waiting time)
test_cases.assumptions: The specific values for N and T are configured in the test environment according to SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1. The test environment allows monitoring of OBU internal state and message transmission.

steps.action: Trigger the OBU to start the termination of communication session procedure.
steps.expected: OBU sends the first 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: Do not send any acknowledgement from the trackside. Wait for the OBU to send the message N times in total.
steps.expected: OBU has sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message exactly N times.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T to elapse after the Nth (last) message was sent, without sending any acknowledgement.
steps.expected: OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: Session not terminated if acknowledgement received within waiting time
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it is sending 'Termination of Communication Session' messages. The 'defined number of times' is N. The 'fixed waiting time' is T.
test_cases.test_inputs: N (max retries), T (waiting time)
test_cases.assumptions: The specific values for N and T are configured in the test environment according to SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Trigger the OBU to start the termination of communication session procedure.
steps.expected: OBU sends the first 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: Do not send any acknowledgement. Wait for the OBU to send the message N times in total.
steps.expected: OBU has sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message exactly N times.

steps.action: Send an acknowledgement from the trackside within the fixed waiting time T after the Nth message.
steps.expected: OBU does not consider the communication session terminated immediately. The session termination process is handled according to the acknowledgement receipt (e.g., session ends gracefully or state updates to reflect acknowledgement).

test_cases.title: Session not terminated if retries are less than defined number and no ack
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it is sending 'Termination of Communication Session' messages. The 'defined number of times' is N. The 'fixed waiting time' is T.
test_cases.test_inputs: N (max retries), T (waiting time)
test_cases.assumptions: The specific values for N and T are configured in the test environment according to SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1. N > 1.

steps.action: Trigger the OBU to start the termination of communication session procedure.
steps.expected: OBU sends the first 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: Do not send any acknowledgement. Wait for the OBU to send the message N-1 times in total.
steps.expected: OBU has sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message exactly N-1 times.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T to elapse after the (N-1)th message.
steps.expected: OBU does not consider the communication session terminated because the defined number of times (N) has not been reached. It may continue to wait or retry depending on the specific protocol state machine, but the specific condition for termination in ETC-014 is not met.

test_cases.title: Yol kenarı (trackside) emri üzerine GSM-R kayıt emrinin verilmesi

test_cases.title: Active cab defines train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and connected to the train control system. The train is in a state where cab activation is possible.
test_cases.test_inputs: Activate Cab A. Activate Cab B.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a readable status or interface to verify the defined train orientation (front direction).

steps.action: Activate Cab A.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation with the side of Cab A as the front of the train.

steps.action: Deactivate Cab A and activate Cab B.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the train orientation to define the side of Cab B as the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Last active cab defines orientation when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. Cab A was the last active cab before deactivation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Deactivate all cabs.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU retains the memory of the last active cab. The orientation status is observable.

steps.action: Ensure Cab A is active and defines the front.
steps.expected: Train orientation is set to Cab A side.

steps.action: Deactivate Cab A so that no cab is active.
steps.expected: The OBU maintains the train orientation defined by the last active cab (Cab A side) as the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Orientation update after re-activation of a different cab
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. No cab is currently active. The last active cab was Cab A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Activate Cab B.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly tracks cab activation events.

steps.action: Verify current orientation is based on last active cab (Cab A).
steps.expected: Train orientation is defined by Cab A side.

steps.action: Activate Cab B.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the train orientation to define the side of the newly active cab (Cab B) as the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Konum tabanlı bilgi denetimi için ön uç tahmini konumunun referans olarak kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, trenin hareket halinde olduğu ve konum tabanlı bir bilgiyi (örneğin, bir sinyal konumu veya bölge sınırı) denetlediği bir senaryoda çalışmaktadır. SUBSET-026'da bu spesifik işlev için başka bir referans (maksimum güvenli ön uç veya minimum güvenli arka uç) belirtilmemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu: 1000 m. Denetlenen konum tabanlı bilginin konumu: 1050 m.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun konum hesaplama modülü, tahmini ön uç konumunu doğru olarak üretebilmektedir. Denetlenen işlev, SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'da istisna olarak belirtilenler (End Section timer, Overlap timer, level transition, RBC/RBC border) arasında yer almamaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'ya trenin tahmini ön uç konumunun 1000 m olduğu bilgisi verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, içsel tren konumu referansını 1000 m olarak ayarlar.

steps.action: OBU, 1050 m konumunda bulunan konum tabanlı bir bilgiyi denetlemeye başlar.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim hesabında 1000 m (tahmini ön uç konumu) değerini tren konumu referansı olarak kullanır.

steps.action: OBU'nun denetim sonucunu gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: OBU, konum karşılaştırmasını 1000 m referansına göre yapar ve ilgili işlevin durumunu buna göre günceller.

test_cases.title: SUBSET-026 istisnası: End Section timer için maksimum güvenli ön uç referansının kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, End Section timer'ı denetlemektedir. SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'ya göre bu işlev için referans 'maksimum güvenli ön uç'tur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu: 1000 m. Trenin maksimum güvenli ön uç konumu: 1020 m. End Section timer başlangıç konumu: 1010 m.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, maksimum güvenli ön uç konumunu doğru olarak hesaplayabilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU'ya trenin tahmini ön uç konumunun 1000 m ve maksimum güvenli ön uç konumunun 1020 m olduğu bilgisi verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, her iki konum değerini de içsel olarak tutar.

steps.action: OBU, 1010 m konumunda bulunan End Section timer başlangıç noktasını denetler.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim hesabında 1020 m (maksimum güvenli ön uç) değerini tren konumu referansı olarak kullanır, 1000 m (tahmini ön uç) değerini kullanmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun End Section timer durumunu gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: OBU, timer'ın başlatılıp başlatılmayacağına karar verirken 1020 m referansını temel alır.

test_cases.title: SUBSET-026 istisnası: Level transition border için minimum güvenli arka uç referansının kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir level transition border'ı (seviye geçiş sınırı) denetlemektedir. SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'ya göre bu işlev için referans 'minimum güvenli arka uç'tur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu: 1000 m. Trenin minimum güvenli arka uç konumu: 950 m. Level transition border konumu: 960 m.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, minimum güvenli arka uç konumunu doğru olarak hesaplayabilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU'ya trenin tahmini ön uç konumunun 1000 m ve minimum güvenli arka uç konumunun 950 m olduğu bilgisi verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, her iki konum değerini de içsel olarak tutar.

steps.action: OBU, 960 m konumunda bulunan level transition border'ı denetler.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim hesabında 950 m (minimum güvenli arka uç) değerini tren konumu referansı olarak kullanır, 1000 m (tahmini ön uç) değerini kullanmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun level transition geçiş durumunu gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: OBU, geçişin gerçekleşip gerçekleşmediğine karar verirken 950 m referansını temel alır.

test_cases.title: Report position to RBC referring to last passed compliant LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A compliant LRBG (Balise Group) has been passed. The RBC is connected and ready to receive position reports.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data, LRBG ID of the last passed compliant balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8 for compliance are met for the selected LRBG.

steps.action: Move the train past a compliant LRBG (Balise Group) that meets the conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies the LRBG as the last passed compliant LRBG.

steps.action: Trigger a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC. The report references the last passed compliant LRBG.

test_cases.title: Accept trackside information referring to recently reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has reported its position to the RBC referencing a specific LRBG (LRBG_A). The RBC is connected.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside information (e.g., movement authority) referencing LRBG_A.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG_A is within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: Ensure the OBU has recently reported its position to the RBC referencing LRBG_A.
steps.expected: The RBC acknowledges the position report referencing LRBG_A.

steps.action: Send trackside information from the RBC that references LRBG_A.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the trackside information.

test_cases.title: Reject trackside information referring to LRBG outside recent report window
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has reported its position to the RBC referencing a specific LRBG (LRBG_Current). The RBC is connected.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside information referencing an LRBG (LRBG_Old) that is not within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG_Old is older than the window defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: Ensure the OBU has recently reported its position to the RBC referencing LRBG_Current.
steps.expected: The RBC acknowledges the position report referencing LRBG_Current.

steps.action: Send trackside information from the RBC that references LRBG_Old.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the trackside information.

test_cases.title: Compliance check for linked LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A LRBG is marked as linked and announced in linking.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data, LRBG ID of a linked and announced balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: Linking consistency is checked for this LRBG.

steps.action: Move the train past a LRBG that is marked as linked and announced in linking.
steps.expected: The OBU checks linking consistency for the LRBG.

steps.action: Trigger a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the position to the RBC referring to this LRBG, as it is compliant based on the linking consistency check.

test_cases.title: Compliance check for unlinked LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A LRBG is not marked as unlinked (i.e., it is either linked or not subject to linking consistency check in a way that makes it compliant).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data, LRBG ID of a balise group not marked as unlinked.
test_cases.assumptions: The LRBG is not marked as unlinked, so compliance is determined by the 'not marked as unlinked' condition.

steps.action: Move the train past a LRBG that is not marked as unlinked.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the LRBG compliant based on the 'not marked as unlinked' condition.

steps.action: Trigger a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the position to the RBC referring to this LRBG.

test_cases.title: Reject data valid in one direction when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where the train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., initial power-up or loss of orientation reference).
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise transmission containing data valid only in the forward direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to indicate data rejection (e.g., error log or status flag).

steps.action: Transmit a balise message containing data valid only in the forward direction to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data and does not update its internal state with the received information.

steps.action: Check the OBU status or error log for the rejected data event.
steps.expected: The OBU records that the data was rejected due to unknown orientation/direction.

test_cases.title: Evaluate data valid in both directions when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where the train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise transmission containing data valid in both directions.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to indicate successful data evaluation (e.g., status flag or state update).

steps.action: Transmit a balise message containing data valid in both directions to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and evaluates the data, updating its internal state accordingly.

steps.action: Check the OBU status for the evaluated data.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates that the data was successfully processed.

test_cases.title: Reject one-directional data from any transmission medium when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where the train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device.
test_cases.test_inputs: A transmission from a different medium (e.g., GSM-R or other valid medium if applicable in the test setup) containing data valid only in one direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows simulating data from a transmission medium other than balises, or the requirement is interpreted to apply to all media as stated ('from any transmission medium').

steps.action: Transmit data valid only in one direction via a non-balise transmission medium to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

steps.action: Verify the OBU's internal state.
steps.expected: The OBU's state is not modified by the rejected data.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: incremental distance application
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and process continuous profile data (SUBSET-026 §3.6.3.2.2).
test_cases.test_inputs: Profile data sequence: [10, 20, 30].
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes a debug interface or log that allows verification of the applied profile value for a specific distance range.

steps.action: Send the continuous profile data sequence [10, 20, 30] to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data without error.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the profile value applied at distance 0.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the value 10 (the first received value applies over the first distance).

steps.action: Query the OBU for the profile value applied at distance 10.

test_cases.title: Interpretation of unsigned distance increments

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items when a new balise group becomes SOLR
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A balise group BG_A is currently the SOLR. A location item LI_1 is defined with a distance of 100m relative to BG_A. A new balise group BG_B is detected and becomes the new SOLR. The distance between BG_A and BG_B is known from linking information as 50m (BG_B is 50m ahead of BG_A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG_A (SOLR), Location Item LI_1 (dist=100m, ref=BG_A), Balise group BG_B (new SOLR), Linking info: dist(BG_A, BG_B)=50m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly identifies BG_B as the new SOLR upon detection. The linking information provides the exact distance between the former and new SOLR.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG_B and update SOLR to BG_B.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG_B as the new SOLR.

steps.action: Evaluate the location item LI_1 relative to the new SOLR BG_B.
steps.expected: The distance of LI_1 is recalculated as 100m - 50m = 50m relative to BG_B.

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the location item LI_1.
steps.expected: The location item LI_1 is stored with a distance of 50m and reference balise group BG_B.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items when evaluating non-SOLR referenced information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. Balise group BG_A is the current SOLR. A location item LI_2 is defined with a distance of 200m relative to a non-SOLR balise group BG_C. The distance between BG_C and BG_A (SOLR) is known from travelled distance as 100m (BG_C is 100m behind BG_A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG_A (SOLR), Location Item LI_2 (dist=200m, ref=BG_C), Travelled distance info: dist(BG_C, BG_A)=100m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU evaluates location based information referred to BG_C while BG_A is the SOLR. The travelled distance calculation is accurate.

steps.action: Trigger evaluation of location based information referred to BG_C.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the relocation process for LI_2.

steps.action: Calculate the new distance of LI_2 relative to SOLR BG_A.
steps.expected: The distance is recalculated as 200m - (-100m) = 300m (since BG_C is behind BG_A, the offset is negative, so subtracting a negative adds). Alternatively, if the formula is strictly 'subtract distance between former ref and SOLR', and distance is signed: 200 - (-100) = 300. If distance is magnitude and direction is handled by sign: 200 + 100 = 300.

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the location item LI_2.
steps.expected: The location item LI_2 is stored with a distance of 300m and reference balise group BG_A.

test_cases.title: Relocation with min/max adjustments (Boundary)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. Balise group BG_A is the current SOLR. A location item LI_3 is defined with a distance of 10m relative to BG_A. A new balise group BG_B becomes SOLR. The distance between BG_A and BG_B is 20m (BG_B is 20m ahead). The calculated new distance is 10m - 20m = -10m. According to SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.2.5, if the resulting distance is outside the valid range (e.g., negative or exceeding max), min/max adjustments apply. Assume the minimum valid distance is 0m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG_A (SOLR), Location Item LI_3 (dist=10m, ref=BG_A), Balise group BG_B (new SOLR), Linking info: dist(BG_A, BG_B)=20m.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum valid distance for a location item is 0m. The OBU applies the min adjustment as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.2.5.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG_B and update SOLR to BG_B.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG_B as the new SOLR.

steps.action: Calculate the new distance of LI_3 relative to BG_B.
steps.expected: The raw calculated distance is 10m - 20m = -10m.

steps.action: Apply min/max adjustments to the calculated distance.
steps.expected: The distance is adjusted to the minimum valid value of 0m.

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the location item LI_3.
steps.expected: The location item LI_3 is stored with a distance of 0m and reference balise group BG_B.

test_cases.title: Relocation using travelled distance when linking information is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. Balise group BG_A is the current SOLR. A location item LI_4 is defined with a distance of 50m relative to BG_A. A new balise group BG_B becomes SOLR. Linking information between BG_A and BG_B is unavailable. The OBU has recorded a travelled distance of 30m since passing BG_A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG_A (SOLR), Location Item LI_4 (dist=50m, ref=BG_A), Balise group BG_B (new SOLR), Travelled distance since BG_A = 30m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU uses the travelled distance as the distance between the former SOLR (BG_A) and the new SOLR (BG_B) when linking information is not available.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG_B and update SOLR to BG_B.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG_B as the new SOLR.

steps.action: Determine the distance between BG_A and BG_B using travelled distance.
steps.expected: The distance is determined to be 30m.

steps.action: Calculate the new distance of LI_4 relative to BG_B.
steps.expected: The distance is recalculated as 50m - 30m = 20m.

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the location item LI_4.
steps.expected: The location item LI_4 is stored with a distance of 20m and reference balise group BG_B.

steps.action: Simulate the train continuing to move away from Location A until the estimated distance equals the defined roll-away limit.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position supervision with zero distance to former EOA/LOA
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Override mode without valid position. The distance to the former EOA/LOA is zero. The system has estimated, max safe, and min safe front end values available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance: 1000 m. Distance travelled: 100 m. Odometer correction: 0 m. Estimated front end: 50 m. Max safe front end: 60 m. Min safe front end: 40 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates the remaining distance based on the estimated front end as the primary reference for supervision in this scenario.

steps.action: Initiate Override mode without valid position with zero distance to former EOA/LOA.
steps.expected: OBU enters supervision mode for virtual train front position.

steps.action: Simulate travel of 100 m with no odometer error.
steps.expected: OBU calculates remaining distance as 1000 m - 100 m = 900 m.

steps.action: Verify the supervised distance value displayed or logged by the OBU.
steps.expected: The supervised distance reflects the calculated remaining distance of 900 m.

test_cases.title: Correction for odometer under-reading in virtual front position calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising virtual train front position. Odometer is configured to simulate an under-reading error.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance: 1000 m. Actual distance travelled: 100 m. Odometer reading: 90 m (under-reading of 10 m). Estimated front end: 50 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU corrects the distance travelled by adding the under-reading error to the odometer value to derive the true distance travelled.

steps.action: Simulate travel where the odometer reads 90 m but the actual distance is 100 m.
steps.expected: OBU detects the discrepancy or applies the predefined correction factor for under-reading.

steps.action: Verify the calculated remaining distance.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated using the corrected distance travelled (100 m), resulting in 1000 m - 100 m = 900 m, not 1000 m - 90 m = 910 m.

steps.action: Simulate travel where the odometer reads 110 m but the actual distance is 100 m.

steps.action: Verify the calculated remaining distance.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated using the corrected distance travelled (100 m), resulting in 1000 m - 100 m = 900 m, not 1000 m - 110 m = 890 m.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Distance travelled equals supervised distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising virtual train front position.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance: 1000 m. Distance travelled: 1000 m. Odometer correction: 0 m.

steps.action: Simulate travel of exactly 1000 m.
steps.expected: The distance travelled reaches the supervised distance.

steps.action: Check the supervised remaining distance.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is 1000 m - 1000 m = 0 m.

test_cases.title: Error handling: Distance travelled exceeds supervised distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising virtual train front position.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance: 1000 m. Distance travelled: 1050 m. Odometer correction: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU handles negative remaining distance by clamping to zero or triggering a specific safety reaction as defined in the broader system context, but for this specific calculation, the mathematical result is negative.

steps.action: Simulate travel of 1050 m, exceeding the supervised distance of 1000 m.
steps.expected: The calculated remaining distance is mathematically -50 m.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's response to the negative remaining distance.
steps.expected: The OBU either clamps the remaining distance to 0 m or initiates a safety reaction (e.g., brake demand) as per the overall safety concept, ensuring the virtual front position does not report a negative physical distance.

test_cases.title: Replacement of stored track description upon receipt of new information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where it can receive track description data. A valid track description of a specific type (e.g., Track Condition) is already stored in the OBU memory.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new track description message of the same type as the stored one, with a different start location and content.
test_cases.assumptions: The new track description is valid and conforms to SUBSET-026. The 'per-type rules' imply that the new information replaces the old one for the overlapping or defined scope.

steps.action: Transmit a new track description message to the OBU for a specific track condition type.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and acknowledges it (if applicable) or processes it internally.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the stored track description of that type.
steps.expected: The stored information matches the content of the newly received track description, indicating the old information was replaced.

test_cases.title: Replacement of stored linking information from reference balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored linking information associated with a specific reference balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information referencing the same balise group but with updated parameters.
test_cases.assumptions: The new linking information is valid. The replacement starts from the reference balise group as per the requirement.

steps.action: Transmit new linking information to the OBU that references the same balise group as the currently stored information.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new linking information.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the linking information associated with that reference balise group.
steps.expected: The stored linking information is updated to reflect the new data, replacing the previous information for that group.

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of track description from start location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a long track description stored, covering a range of track sections. The new information covers only a subset of this range, starting from a specific location within the existing stored range.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new track description message that starts at a location within the previously stored track description range.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'per-type rules' allow for replacement from the start location of the new information, meaning data before the new start location remains unchanged, and data from the new start location onwards is replaced or updated according to the rules.

steps.action: Transmit a new track description that starts at a location within the range of the currently stored track description.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the new information.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the track description data before the start location of the new information.
steps.expected: The data before the new start location remains unchanged from the previous storage.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the track description data from the start location of the new information onwards.
steps.expected: The data from the new start location onwards reflects the new information, having replaced the old data in that segment.

test_cases.title: Handling of invalid new track description
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid track description information stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A malformed or invalid track description message (e.g., checksum error, out-of-range values).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is expected to reject invalid messages and retain the previously stored valid information.

steps.action: Transmit an invalid track description message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message (e.g., logs an error, does not update memory).

steps.action: Query the OBU for the stored track description.
steps.expected: The stored information remains unchanged and matches the previously valid data.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation-location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can request an MA (e.g., in a section without a valid MA or with an expiring MA). The RBC is available and connected. The perturbation-location criterion is configured and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train front position data simulating passage of the perturbation location.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific location for the perturbation criterion is known and can be simulated in the test environment.

steps.action: Simulate the train front moving towards the location defined by the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC before the location is reached.

steps.action: Simulate the train front passing the location defined by the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can request an MA. The RBC is available and connected. The Section timer or LOA speed timer criterion is active and counting down.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time progression or speed data to trigger the timer criterion.
test_cases.assumptions: The timer value for the Section/LOA speed criterion is known and can be manipulated or waited out in the test environment.

steps.action: Allow the Section timer or LOA speed timer to count down towards the threshold defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.1.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC before the timer threshold is reached.

steps.action: Reach the moment defined by the Section timer or LOA speed timer criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation criterion before timer expires
test_cases.preconditions: Both the perturbation-location criterion and the Section/LOA speed timer criterion are active. The timer has not yet reached its threshold.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train front position data simulating passage of the perturbation location.
test_cases.assumptions: The perturbation location is reached before the timer threshold.

steps.action: Simulate the train front passing the location defined by the perturbation-location criterion while the timer is still running.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request to the RBC immediately upon passing the location, without waiting for the timer to expire.

test_cases.title: No MA request if neither criterion is met
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can request an MA. The RBC is available. The train is moving within the section, but has not passed the perturbation location, and the timer has not reached its threshold.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train front position data and time progression that do not meet either criterion.
test_cases.assumptions: The train remains within the valid section and the timer is reset or not yet triggered.

steps.action: Simulate train movement within the section without passing the perturbation location and without reaching the timer threshold.
steps.expected: The OBU does not trigger an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: End Section timer starts when max safe front end passes start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive trackside data. The 'End Section timer start location' has been received from trackside and is valid.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside data containing a specific 'End Section timer start location' (e.g., 1000m). OBU position data simulating movement.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's 'max safe front end' position is accurately tracked and can be compared against the received location.

steps.action: Configure the OBU to receive an 'End Section timer start location' of 1000m from trackside.
steps.expected: OBU stores the start location value of 1000m.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU's max safe front end position at 999m.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is NOT started (timer value is 0 or inactive).

steps.action: Simulate the OBU's max safe front end position moving to 1001m (passing the 1000m location).
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: End Section timer starts exactly at the start location boundary
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a valid 'End Section timer start location' from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside data with start location at 500m. OBU position data.
test_cases.assumptions: Position resolution allows distinguishing between 499m and 500m.

steps.action: Set the 'End Section timer start location' to 500m.
steps.expected: OBU accepts the location.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU's max safe front end position at exactly 500m.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts (or is considered to have passed the location, triggering the start logic).

test_cases.title: End Section timer does not start if location is not passed
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a valid 'End Section timer start location' from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside data with start location at 1000m. OBU position data.

steps.action: Set the 'End Section timer start location' to 1000m.
steps.expected: OBU accepts the location.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU's max safe front end position at 900m.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is NOT started.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU's max safe front end position moving to 950m.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is still NOT started.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout triggers EOA/LOA withdrawal and speed reset
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode with a valid EOA/LOA. The End Section timer is active and counting down. The trackside has provided a specific time-out value for the End Section.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside End Section time-out value: 10 seconds. Current train position: 1000m. Target speed at End of Movement Authority: 80 km/h. Location based information (LBI) present in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU clock is synchronized and accurate. The train is moving within the End Section.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the trackside-provided time-out value (10 seconds).
steps.expected: The OBU detects the timeout condition.

steps.action: Observe the Movement Authority (MA) limit.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the train's current position (1000m).

steps.action: Check the location based information (LBI) listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The LBI associated with the withdrawn section is deleted from the OBU's active data.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout with zero target speed at EOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode with a valid EOA/LOA. The End Section timer is active. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority is already zero.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside End Section time-out value: 5 seconds. Current train position: 2000m. Target speed at End of Movement Authority: 0 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU clock is synchronized and accurate.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the trackside-provided time-out value (5 seconds).
steps.expected: The OBU detects the timeout condition.

steps.action: Observe the Movement Authority (MA) limit.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the train's current position (2000m).

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed remains zero.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout with no location based information present
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode with a valid EOA/LOA. The End Section timer is active. No location based information (LBI) is currently loaded for the End Section.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside End Section time-out value: 10 seconds. Current train position: 3000m. Target speed at End of Movement Authority: 50 km/h. LBI: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU clock is synchronized and accurate.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the trackside-provided time-out value (10 seconds).
steps.expected: The OBU detects the timeout condition.

steps.action: Observe the Movement Authority (MA) limit.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the train's current position (3000m).

steps.action: Check the location based information (LBI) status.
steps.expected: No LBI deletion error occurs; the system handles the absence of LBI gracefully.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA hız zamanlayıcısının zaman aşımına ulaşması durumunda hızın sıfırlanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, raydan gelen geçerli bir LOA mesajı almış ve LOA hız zamanlayıcısı aktif durumdadır.

steps.expected: OBU, LOA hızını 100 km/s olarak uygular ve zamanlayıcı çalışmaya başlar.

steps.expected: OBU, LOA ile ilişkili hızı sıfıra ayarlar.

steps.expected: LOA, EOA olarak işaretlenir ve SvL değeri ilgili standarda uygun şekilde belirlenir.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Ek A.3.4'te listelenen konum tabanlı bilgilerin silinip silinmediği kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: İlgili konum tabanlı bilgiler OBU'dan silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer starts when max safe front end passes start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has received a valid Overlap timer start location and a finite time-out value from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: Max safe front end position: Just before the Overlap timer start location, then moving past it.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface or log to observe the state of the Overlap timer.

steps.action: Position the OBU's max safe front end just before the received Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is not started (state: inactive or 0).

steps.action: Move the OBU so that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting down from the received time-out value.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer starts when time-out value is 'infinite'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has received a valid Overlap timer start location and a time-out value of 'infinite' from trackside.

steps.expected: The Overlap timer is not started.

steps.action: Move the OBU so that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is regarded as started (state: active), even though the time-out value is 'infinite'.

steps.expected: The Overlap timer remains not started and no timeout event is triggered.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout triggers deletion and speed reset
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode with a valid Movement Authority (MA) that includes an overlap. The trackside has provided a specific overlap timer value. The OBU is currently supervising a location within the overlap.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside overlap timer value: 10 seconds. Initial target speed at End of MA: 120 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU clock is synchronized and accurate. The 'Supervised Location' and 'End of Movement Authority' are clearly defined in the current MA structure.

steps.action: Start the OBU with a valid MA containing an overlap and a non-zero target speed at the End of MA.
steps.expected: OBU displays the current target speed (120 km/h) and the overlap is active. The overlap timer starts counting down from the trackside value.

steps.action: Wait until the overlap timer exceeds the trackside-defined time-out value (e.g., wait 11 seconds).
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the overlap and its associated release speed. The OBU redetermines the Supervised Location per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

steps.action: Check the OBU status and speed profile.
steps.expected: The overlap is no longer present in the MA. The target speed at the End of MA is displayed as 0 km/h. The Supervised Location is updated according to the deletion rules in Appendix A.3.4.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout with zero target speed at End of MA
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode with a valid MA that includes an overlap. The target speed at the End of MA is already zero.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside overlap timer value: 5 seconds. Initial target speed at End of MA: 0 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly handles the case where the target speed is already zero.

steps.action: Start the OBU with a valid MA containing an overlap and a zero target speed at the End of MA.
steps.expected: OBU displays the current target speed (0 km/h) and the overlap is active. The overlap timer starts counting down.

steps.action: Wait until the overlap timer exceeds the trackside-defined time-out value (e.g., wait 6 seconds).
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the overlap and its associated release speed. The OBU redetermines the Supervised Location per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority remains zero.

steps.action: Check the OBU status and speed profile.
steps.expected: The overlap is no longer present in the MA. The target speed at the End of MA is displayed as 0 km/h. The Supervised Location is updated according to the deletion rules in Appendix A.3.4.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout boundary condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode with a valid MA that includes an overlap. The trackside has provided a specific overlap timer value.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside overlap timer value: 10 seconds. Initial target speed at End of MA: 100 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU timer resolution is sufficient to distinguish between exactly the timeout value and exceeding it.

steps.action: Start the OBU with a valid MA containing an overlap and a non-zero target speed at the End of MA.
steps.expected: OBU displays the current target speed (100 km/h) and the overlap is active. The overlap timer starts counting down.

steps.action: Wait until the overlap timer reaches exactly the trackside-defined time-out value (10 seconds).
steps.expected: The overlap is still active. The target speed at the End of MA remains 100 km/h. No deletion or speed reset occurs.

steps.action: Wait for a short duration (e.g., 100 ms) so that the timer exceeds the time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the overlap and its associated release speed. The OBU redetermines the Supervised Location per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap zamanlayıcısı çalışırken trenin durması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Overlap zamanlayıcısını başlatacak bir durumdadır (örn. sinyal geçişi veya Overlap bölgesine giriş).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin durdurulması komutu veya fren uygulaması.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2'de tanımlanan sonuçlar, OBU'nun hareket yetkisini (MA) kısıtlaması veya durdurma emri vermesi şeklinde gözlemlenebilir.

steps.action: Overlap zamanlayıcısının başlatılmasına neden olan koşullar sağlanır.
steps.expected: Overlap zamanlayıcısının çalışmaya başladığı OBU durumundan veya log kayıtlarından doğrulanır.

steps.action: Zamanlayıcı süresi dolmadan önce tren durdurulur.
steps.expected: Tren durur.

steps.action: OBU'nun Overlap zamanlayıcısı durumuna ve uyguladığı sonuçlara bakılır.
steps.expected: OBU, Overlap zamanlayıcısını 'süresi dolmuş' (expired) olarak işler ve SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2'de tanımlanan sonuçları uygular (örn. hareket yetkisinin kısıtlanması veya durma emri).

test_cases.title: Overlap zamanlayıcısı çalışırken trenin durmaması (Karşılaştırma)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Overlap zamanlayıcısını başlatacak bir durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin hareket halinde kalması.
test_cases.assumptions: Tren, Overlap bölgesini zamanlayıcı süresi dolmadan geçer.

steps.action: Overlap zamanlayıcısının başlatılmasına neden olan koşullar sağlanır.
steps.expected: Overlap zamanlayıcısının çalışmaya başladığı doğrulanır.

steps.action: Tren, zamanlayıcı süresi dolmadan Overlap bölgesini geçer ve durmaz.
steps.expected: Tren hareketine devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun Overlap zamanlayıcısı durumuna bakılır.
steps.expected: Overlap zamanlayıcısı 'süresi dolmuş' olarak işaretlenmez; SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2'deki zaman aşımı sonuçları uygulanmaz.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start location behind max safe front end with no running timer
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No Overlap timer is currently running. The OBU has a defined max safe front end position.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new Movement Authority (MA) is received where the Overlap timer start location is located behind the OBU's max safe front end.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be configured to report the status of the Overlap timer and the applied safety action (e.g., braking command or speed restriction) for verification.

steps.action: Send a new MA to the OBU with an Overlap timer start location behind the max safe front end while no Overlap timer is running.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the MA and detects that the Overlap timer start location is behind the max safe front end.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's internal state regarding the Overlap timer.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the Overlap timer to have exceeded its time-out value.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's safety action.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the actions defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 (typically resulting in a braking command or speed restriction to ensure safety).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location selection when Overlap exists and is valid
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it determines the Supervised Location. The track database contains an Overlap, a Danger Point, and an End Section for the current route. The Overlap has not timed out.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route configuration with valid Overlap, Danger Point, and End Section.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface or log allows observation of the calculated Supervised Location.

steps.action: Configure the OBU with a route where an Overlap exists and has not timed out.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the Supervised Location.

steps.action: Observe the determined Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the end of the Overlap.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location selection when Overlap is timed out
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it determines the Supervised Location. The track database contains an Overlap, a Danger Point, and an End Section for the current route. The Overlap has timed out.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface or log allows observation of the calculated Supervised Location.

steps.expected: The OBU calculates the Supervised Location.

steps.action: Observe the determined Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the Danger Point.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location selection when Overlap and Danger Point are absent
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it determines the Supervised Location. The track database does not contain an Overlap or a Danger Point for the current route, but contains an End Section.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route configuration without Overlap and without Danger Point, with valid End Section.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface or log allows observation of the calculated Supervised Location.

steps.expected: The OBU calculates the Supervised Location.

steps.action: Observe the determined Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
