test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly identifies the reference between the infill MA and the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Provide the main signal balise group data including valid linking information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the linking information for the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Provide the infill MA that references the main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: RBC'den gelen yeni MA ile önceki MA verilerinin tamamen değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC'den gelen geçerli bir MA (MA_old) almış ve aktif olarak kullanmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen yeni bir MA (MA_new) mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: MA_new, MA_old'dan farklı bir hareket izni (örn. daha kısa veya uzun mesafe) içermektedir.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut MA verileri (MA_old) gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA_old verilerini (hız limiti, hareket izni mesafesi vb.) tutmaktadır.

steps.action: RBC'den MA_new mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA_new mesajını alır ve işler.

steps.action: OBU'nun güncel MA verileri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA_old verilerinin tamamını silmiş ve MA_new verilerini (hız limiti, hareket izni mesafesi vb.) aktif olarak kullanmaktadır.

test_cases.title: Ana sinyal baliz grubundan gelen yeni MA ile önceki MA verilerinin tamamen değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA (MA_old) almış ve aktif olarak kullanmaktadır. Ana sinyal baliz grubu (non-infill) okunmaya hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ana sinyal baliz grubundan gelen yeni bir MA (MA_new) verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Baliz grubu, 'non-infill' (ana sinyal) bilgisi olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut MA verileri (MA_old) gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA_old verilerini tutmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU, ana sinyal baliz grubundan MA_new verisini okur.
steps.expected: OBU, baliz verisini alır ve işler.

steps.action: OBU'nun güncel MA verileri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA_old verilerinin tamamını silmiş ve MA_new verilerini aktif olarak kullanmaktadır.

test_cases.title: Infill baliz grubundan gelen MA ile sadece ileriye dönük verilerin güncellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA (MA_old) almış ve aktif olarak kullanmaktadır. Infill baliz grubu okunmaya hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill baliz grubundan gelen yeni bir MA (MA_infill) verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: MA_infill, mevcut konumun ötesindeki bir ana sinyal baliz grubuna kadar olan verileri içermektedir. Mevcut konum, MA_infill'daki 'duyurulan baliz grubu'ndan önce bir noktadadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut MA verileri (MA_old) gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA_old verilerini tutmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU, infill baliz grubundan MA_infill verisini okur.
steps.expected: OBU, baliz verisini alır ve işler.

steps.action: OBU'nun güncel MA verileri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, mevcut konumdan 'duyurulan baliz grubu'na kadar olan verileri MA_old'dan korur. 'Duyurulan baliz grubu'nun ötesindeki verileri MA_infill'dan alır ve kullanır.

test_cases.title: Infill MA receipt triggers new MA section at next main signal
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive MA messages. An infill MA is available for transmission.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message containing a location reference corresponding to the balise group at the next main signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is correctly configured to process infill MAs. The location reference in the infill MA is valid and corresponds to a known balise group at a main signal.

steps.action: Transmit an infill MA to the OBU with a location reference pointing to the balise group at the next main signal.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the infill MA and processes it.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for the start of a new MA section.
steps.expected: A new MA section is started at the location reference specified in the infill MA (the balise group at the next main signal).

test_cases.title: Infill MA with invalid location reference does not start new MA section
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive MA messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message containing an invalid or non-existent location reference.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU validates the location reference in the infill MA against known balise groups.

steps.action: Transmit an infill MA to the OBU with an invalid location reference.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the infill MA but does not start a new MA section.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for any new MA section.
steps.expected: No new MA section is started. The OBU may log an error or ignore the invalid reference.

test_cases.title: SvL mevcut LOA içindeyken MA kısaltma işleminin doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir LOA (Line of Authority) ile seyahat etmektedir. SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te listelenen konum tabanlı bilgiler (örn. sinyal durumları, hız kısıtlamaları) bellekte saklanmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni MA mesajı: SvL, mevcut LOA'nın içinde (başlangıç noktasından sonra, mevcut LOA sonundan önce) bir konumda tanımlanır.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun mevcut LOA uzunluğu 1000m'dir. Yeni MA'daki SvL 500m konumundadır. SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te 750m konumunda bir hız kısıtlaması bilgisi saklanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'ya SvL'si mevcut LOA içinde (500m) olan yeni bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu MA'yı bir 'MA kısaltma' (MA shortening) olayı olarak işler.

steps.action: OBU'nun yeni LOA değerini gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: Yeni LOA, SvL konumu olan 500m olarak güncellenir.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te listelenen ve yeni LOA sınırının (500m) ötesinde kalan konum tabanlı bilgilerin (örn. 750m'deki hız kısıtlaması) bellekteki durumunu kontrol edin.
steps.expected: Yeni LOA sınırının ötesinde kalan konum tabanlı bilgiler silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: SvL mevcut LOA sonundan ötede olsa bile MA kısaltma olarak işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir LOA ile seyahat etmektedir. SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te listelenen konum tabanlı bilgiler bellekte saklanmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni MA mesajı: SvL, mevcut LOA sonundan ötede bir konumda tanımlanır.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun mevcut LOA uzunluğu 1000m'dir. Yeni MA'daki SvL 1500m konumundadır. SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te 1200m konumunda bir konum tabanlı bilgi saklanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'ya SvL'si mevcut LOA sonundan ötede (1500m) olan yeni bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu MA'yı bir 'MA kısaltma' (MA shortening) olayı olarak işler. (Gereksinim, SvL'nin nerede olursa olsun her zaman kısaltma olarak ele alınacağını belirtir.)

steps.action: OBU'nun yeni LOA değerini gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: Yeni LOA, SvL konumu olan 1500m olarak güncellenir.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te listelenen ve yeni LOA sınırının (1500m) ötesinde kalan konum tabanlı bilgilerin bellekteki durumunu kontrol edin.
steps.expected: Yeni LOA sınırının ötesinde kalan konum tabanlı bilgiler silinmiştir. 1200m'deki bilgi yeni LOA içinde kaldığı için silinmemelidir.

test_cases.title: SvL mevcut LOA başlangıcından önceyse MA kısaltma olarak işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir LOA ile seyahat etmektedir. SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te listelenen konum tabanlı bilgiler bellekte saklanmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni MA mesajı: SvL, mevcut LOA başlangıcından önce (negatif veya daha küçük bir konum) tanımlanır.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun mevcut LOA başlangıcı 0m, sonu 1000m'dir. Yeni MA'daki SvL -100m konumundadır. SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te 50m konumunda bir konum tabanlı bilgi saklanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'ya SvL'si mevcut LOA başlangıcından önce (-100m) olan yeni bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu MA'yı bir 'MA kısaltma' (MA shortening) olayı olarak işler.

steps.action: OBU'nun yeni LOA değerini gözlemleyin.
steps.expected: Yeni LOA, SvL konumu olan -100m olarak güncellenir (veya sistem tarafından izin verilen minimum değere ayarlanır, ancak gereksinim SvL'ye göre silme yapmayı belirtir).

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te listelenen ve yeni LOA sınırının (-100m) ötesinde kalan konum tabanlı bilgilerin bellekteki durumunu kontrol edin.
steps.expected: Tüm mevcut konum tabanlı bilgiler (örn. 50m'deki bilgi) yeni LOA sınırının ötesinde kaldığı için silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information receipt does not trigger MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a valid operational state with an active Movement Authority (MA). The current MA length is known and stable.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid repositioning message (e.g., via Eurobalise or RBC communication) that updates the train's position but does not alter the MA limits.
test_cases.assumptions: The repositioning message is syntactically and semantically valid according to ETCS specifications.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's internal state regarding MA shortening flags or alarms.
steps.expected: No MA shortening flag is set, and no related alarm is active.

steps.action: Transmit a valid repositioning information message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the repositioning information and updates its position estimate.

steps.action: Check the OBU's status for MA shortening indication.
steps.expected: The OBU does not regard the event as an MA shortening. No MA shortening alarm or state change is observed.

test_cases.title: New MA ending with LOA is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is currently holding an active Movement Authority (MA) with a specific Limit of Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new Movement Authority (MA) message from the RBC that ends with a new LOA. The new LOA may be at a different location than the previous one, but the message is a complete new MA, not a shortening command.
test_cases.assumptions: The new MA is valid and accepted by the OBU. The scenario simulates a standard MA update where the LOA changes, which must not be misinterpreted as a 'shortening' event in the context of the specific logic defined in ETC-073.

steps.action: Record the current MA status and LOA position in the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the current active MA and its LOA.

steps.action: Transmit a new MA message to the OBU that ends with a new LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA and updates the LOA to the new position.

steps.action: Verify the OBU's internal handling of the MA update.
steps.expected: The OBU does not flag this event as an 'MA shortening'. The system state reflects a new MA, not a shortening of the previous MA.

test_cases.title: Adopt shortened MA when train is rear of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The current MA has an Indication supervision limit (ISL) at position P_ISL. The train front end is at position P_Train, where P_Train < P_ISL.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA to a new MA with ISL at P_NewISL, where P_NewISL > P_Train. New MA includes a specific mode profile and SH-area balise group list.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be configured to report its decision to the RBC via a specific message (e.g., MA Acknowledgement or similar).

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to the new MA defined in test inputs.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the request.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's internal state for the active MA.
steps.expected: The OBU adopts the new shortened MA, including its mode profile and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Observe the communication from OBU to RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to adopt the new MA.

test_cases.title: Reject shortened MA when train is at or ahead of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The current MA has an Indication supervision limit (ISL) at position P_ISL. The train front end is at position P_Train, where P_Train >= P_ISL.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA to a new MA with ISL at P_NewISL, where P_NewISL < P_Train. New MA includes a specific mode profile and SH-area balise group list.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be configured to report its decision to the RBC via a specific message.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to the new MA defined in test inputs.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the request.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's internal state for the active MA.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA and keeps the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Observe the communication from OBU to RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to reject the new MA.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Train front end exactly at Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The current MA has an Indication supervision limit (ISL) at position P_ISL. The train front end is at position P_Train, where P_Train == P_ISL.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA to a new MA with ISL at P_NewISL, where P_NewISL < P_Train.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'in rear of', which implies strictly less than. Therefore, being exactly at the limit is not 'in rear of'.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to the new MA defined in test inputs.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the request.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's internal state for the active MA.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA and keeps the previous MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Observe the communication from OBU to RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a message to the RBC informing it of the decision to reject the new MA.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill ortamı talebinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, desteklenen infill ortamları listesi yapılandırılmıştır. OBU, geçerli bir balis grubundan önceki seyrine ait güncel bilgiyi almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Desteklenmeyen infill ortamı talep eden bir announcement balis grubu simülasyonu.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun desteklemediği bir infill ortamı (örneğin, OBU'da bulunmayan bir radyo frekansı veya protokol) test senaryosunda tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: OBU'ya desteklenmeyen bir infill ortamı talep eden bir announcement balis grubu sinyali verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu talebi yok sayar ve infill ortamı kurulumu için herhangi bir işlem başlatmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun çalışma durumu ve mevcut seyrine ait bilgi akışı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, önceki balis grubundan alınan bilgilere göre çalışmaya devam eder ve seyrine ait parametreler değişmez.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group. A loop antenna is present and capable of transmitting infill information.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Main signal balise group data (valid). 2. Loop infill message (valid).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to log or expose the state of infill information processing for verification purposes.

steps.action: Transmit a valid main signal balise group to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU successfully reads and processes the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit a valid infill information message from the loop antenna to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the infill information; the infill data is not processed or applied to the current signal state.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and expects to read a main signal balise group at a specific location. The balise group is not present or is unreadable (simulated miss). A loop antenna is present and capable of transmitting infill information.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Absence of main signal balise group (simulated miss). 2. Loop infill message (valid).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a defined timeout or distance-based mechanism to detect that the expected main signal balise group was missed.

steps.action: Simulate the passage of the expected main signal balise group location without transmitting the balise data, allowing the OBU to detect the miss.
steps.expected: OBU detects that the main signal balise group was missed.

steps.action: Transmit a valid infill information message from the loop antenna to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the infill information; the infill data is not processed or applied to the current signal state.

test_cases.title: GSM-R kurulu değilken RIB oturum kurma emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, GSM-R radyo sisteminin araçta kurulu olmadığı yapılandırmada çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RIB ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri.

steps.action: OBU'ya RIB ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU emri yok sayar ve RIB ile iletişim oturumu kurma girişiminde bulunmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum kayıtları ve arayüzleri incelenir.
steps.expected: RIB oturum kurma işlemine ait hata, uyarı veya aktivasyon kaydı bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Ordered RIU session establishment upon reaching location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. A balise group containing an order to establish a session with RIU-A at location L1 is available. OBU is not currently connected to any RIU.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data: Order to connect to RIU-A at L1. OBU position: Approaching L1.
test_cases.assumptions: RIU-A is available and ready to accept a session at L1.

steps.action: Move the OBU to the location L1 specified in the balise order.
steps.expected: OBU detects the location L1.

steps.action: Wait for the OBU to process the order.
steps.expected: OBU establishes a communication session with RIU-A.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session with non-ordered RIU
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is currently established in a communication session with RIU-B. A balise group containing an order to establish a session with RIU-A at location L1 is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data: Order to connect to RIU-A at L1. Current session: RIU-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RIU-A is available and ready to accept a session at L1.

steps.action: Move the OBU to the location L1 specified in the balise order.
steps.expected: OBU detects the location L1.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's session status.
steps.expected: The existing session with RIU-B is terminated.

steps.action: Wait for the OBU to establish the new session.
steps.expected: OBU establishes a communication session with RIU-A.

test_cases.title: Session establishment when OBU is busy handling current session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is currently established in a communication session with RIU-B and is actively processing data (busy state). A balise group containing an order to establish a session with RIU-A at location L1 is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data: Order to connect to RIU-A at L1. Current session: RIU-B (busy).
test_cases.assumptions: RIU-A is available. The 'busy' state prevents immediate session switching.

steps.action: Move the OBU to the location L1 specified in the balise order while the OBU is busy.
steps.expected: OBU detects the location L1 but does not immediately terminate the session with RIU-B or connect to RIU-A.

steps.action: Wait until the OBU finishes processing the current data and is able to handle a new session.
steps.expected: OBU terminates the session with RIU-B and establishes a session with RIU-A.

test_cases.title: GSM-R oturumu aktifken Radio Infill Unit oturum kurma emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, GSM-R üzerinden tek bir iletişim oturumu kurma kapasitesine sahiptir (degraded durum). OBU, GSM-R üzerinden aktif bir iletişim oturumu kurmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio Infill Unit'ten gelen iletişim oturumu kurma emri.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun GSM-R oturumu aktif olduğu ve Radio Infill Unit'in emir gönderme yeteneğine sahip olduğu varsayılır.

steps.action: OBU'nun GSM-R üzerinden aktif bir iletişim oturumu kurduğu doğrulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R oturumunun aktif olduğunu gösterir.

steps.action: Radio Infill Unit'ten OBU'ya iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu emri yok sayar ve Radio Infill Unit ile yeni bir iletişim oturumu kurmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut GSM-R oturumunun durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: GSM-R üzerinden kurulan iletişim oturumu kesintisiz devam eder.

test_cases.title: GSM-R oturumu yokken Radio Infill Unit oturum kurma emrinin yok sayılması (degraded durum)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, GSM-R üzerinden tek bir iletişim oturumu kurma kapasitesine sahiptir (degraded durum). OBU, GSM-R üzerinden aktif bir iletişim oturumu kurmamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio Infill Unit'ten gelen iletişim oturumu kurma emri.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun GSM-R oturumu aktif olmadığı ve Radio Infill Unit'in emir gönderme yeteneğine sahip olduğu varsayılır.

steps.action: OBU'nun GSM-R üzerinden aktif bir iletişim oturumu kurmadığı doğrulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R oturumunun aktif olmadığını gösterir.

steps.action: Radio Infill Unit'ten OBU'ya iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu emri yok sayar ve Radio Infill Unit ile yeni bir iletişim oturumu kurmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun iletişim oturumu durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hiçbir iletişim oturumu kurmamış olarak kalır.

test_cases.title: Infill area entry triggers radio infill unit information transmission
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it has received a valid balise group order containing an infill area entry location and a subsequent main signal balise group. The radio infill unit is connected and ready to receive data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group order defining infill entry location and next main signal balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's position tracking is accurate enough to detect passage of the specified location.

steps.action: Move the OBU to the location specified in the balise group order for entry into the infill area.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the radio infill unit immediately upon passing the location.

steps.action: Continue moving the OBU towards the next main signal balise group without reading it yet.
steps.expected: No additional transmission to the radio infill unit occurs until the next main signal balise group is read or missed.

test_cases.title: Reading next main signal balise group triggers radio infill unit information transmission
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has already passed the infill area entry location and sent the initial information to the radio infill unit. The next main signal balise group is present in the balise group order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group order with next main signal balise group defined. Physical or simulated balise group data for the next main signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can successfully read the balise group data.

steps.action: Move the OBU to the location of the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU reads the balise group.

steps.action: Observe the communication between the OBU and the radio infill unit.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the radio infill unit immediately after reading the next main signal balise group.

test_cases.title: Missing next main signal balise group triggers radio infill unit information transmission
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has already passed the infill area entry location and sent the initial information to the radio infill unit. The next main signal balise group is defined in the order but is not present or readable at its expected location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group order with next main signal balise group defined. Absence of the physical balise group or simulation of a read failure.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to detect that the expected balise group was missed (e.g., based on distance traveled or time).

steps.action: Move the OBU past the expected location of the next main signal balise group without reading it.
steps.expected: The OBU detects that the balise group was missed.

steps.action: Observe the communication between the OBU and the radio infill unit.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the radio infill unit immediately after detecting that the balise group was missed.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun RIU'ya gönderdiği mesaj içeriğinin doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU ve RIU arasında radyo bağlantısı kurulmuştur. OBU, geçerli bir ETCS-ID'ye, konum verisine ve zaman damgasına sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli ETCS-ID, geçerli konum raporu, bir sonraki ana sinyal baliz grubu kimliği.
test_cases.assumptions: RIU'dan gelen mesajlar yakalanıp analiz edilebilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU'nun RIU'ya bilgi göndermesi sağlanır.
steps.expected: RIU, OBU'dan bir mesaj alır.

steps.action: Alınan mesaj içeriği incelenir.
steps.expected: Mesajda OBU'nun ETCS-ID'si (tren kimliği) bulunur.

steps.action: Alınan mesaj içeriği incelenir.
steps.expected: Mesajda bir konum raporu (position report) bulunur.

steps.action: Alınan mesaj içeriği incelenir.
steps.expected: Mesajda bir sonraki ana sinyal baliz grubunun kimliği (identifier) bulunur.

steps.action: Alınan mesaj içeriği incelenir.
steps.expected: Mesajda bir zaman damgası (time stamp) bulunur.

test_cases.title: Consistent radio infill data acceptance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive radio infill data. A valid, consistent radio infill data set compliant with SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 and §3.16.3.3 is prepared.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid radio infill data packet with consistent parameters (e.g., matching train ID, valid timestamps, correct checksums).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific consistency rules of SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 and §3.16.3.3 are implemented as per the standard. The test environment allows injection of raw radio data.

steps.action: Inject the valid, consistent radio infill data into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data without raising a consistency error.

steps.action: Check the OBU status or logs for data processing results.
steps.expected: The data is marked as processed/valid and no fault related to radio infill consistency is recorded.

test_cases.title: Inconsistent radio infill data rejection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive radio infill data. An inconsistent radio infill data set violating SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 or §3.16.3.3 is prepared (e.g., mismatched train ID or invalid logical consistency).
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio infill data packet with an inconsistency (e.g., Train ID in data does not match the OBU's configured Train ID, or internal logical contradiction).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific inconsistency chosen is one of the checks defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 or §3.16.3.3.

steps.action: Inject the inconsistent radio infill data into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the inconsistency.

steps.action: Check the OBU status or logs for data processing results.
steps.expected: The data is rejected or flagged as inconsistent. A relevant fault or warning is recorded indicating the consistency check failure.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent radio infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio infill message for the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be configured to simulate reading a balise group.

steps.action: Send a radio infill message related to the next main signal balise group before the OBU reads the balise.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the radio infill information.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU reading the next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU updates its state to indicate the balise group has been read.

steps.action: Send another radio infill message related to the same next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the radio infill information.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent radio infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio infill message for the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be configured to simulate missing a balise group.

steps.action: Send a radio infill message related to the next main signal balise group before the OBU reads or misses the balise.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the radio infill information.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU detecting that the next main signal balise group was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU updates its state to indicate the balise group was missed.

steps.action: Send another radio infill message related to the same next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the radio infill information.

test_cases.title: Termination of communication session upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 and has an active communication session with a Radio Infill Unit (RIU).
test_cases.test_inputs: A termination order message from the trackside (RIU or Balise Group).
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside system is capable of sending a specific termination command to the OBU.

steps.action: Verify that the OBU is currently in an active communication session with the RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU status indicates an active session with the RIU.

steps.action: Send a termination order from the trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the termination order.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's communication status.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the RIU.

test_cases.title: Termination of communication session when leaving Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 and has an active communication session with a Radio Infill Unit (RIU).
test_cases.test_inputs: A command to change the operational level from Level 1 to another level (e.g., Level 2 or Level 0).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports switching operational levels and the switch triggers the termination logic.

steps.action: Verify that the OBU is currently in Level 1 with an active RIU session.
steps.expected: The OBU status shows Level 1 and an active RIU session.

steps.action: Command the OBU to leave Level 1 (e.g., switch to Level 2).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the level change command.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's communication status after the level change.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the RIU.

test_cases.title: Acil durum mesajı onayının doğrulanması

test_cases.title: Acil durdurma aktifken yeni hareket yetkisinin reddedilmesi

test_cases.title: Acil durdurma iptal edildikten sonra hareket yetkisinin kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir acil durdurma mesajı almış ve bu mesajı kabul etmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Acil durdurma iptal mesajı, ardından yeni bir hareket yetkisi (MA) mesajı.

steps.action: OBU'ya yeni bir hareket yetkisi mesajı gönderilir.

test_cases.title: Acil durdurma aktifken ardışık hareket yetkisi denemelerinin reddedilmesi

test_cases.test_inputs: İki adet yeni hareket yetkisi (MA) mesajı.

steps.expected: OBU, hareket yetkisini reddeder.

steps.action: OBU'ya ikinci yeni hareket yetkisi mesajı gönderilir.

test_cases.title: Emergency message revocation acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive and process emergency messages. A valid emergency message has been previously received and stored by the OBU.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is connected to the RBC/trackside equipment capable of sending revocation messages. The general acknowledgement procedure of SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5 is implemented as per the standard.

test_cases.title: Permitted braking distance data receipt and speed restriction computation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends valid permitted braking distance data (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has access to the other inputs required for the computation (e.g., current speed, braking parameters) as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.

steps.action: Trackside sends a new permitted braking distance data packet to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data and computes a new speed restriction value based on the received data and other current inputs.

test_cases.assumptions: SC1 and SC2 are valid sub-conditions defined in SUBSET-026 §3.12.3.4.2.

steps.action: Set SC1 to fulfilled and SC2 to not fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU does not consider the start condition fulfilled.

steps.action: Set SC1 to not fulfilled and SC2 to fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU does not consider the start condition fulfilled.

steps.action: Set both SC1 and SC2 to fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition fulfilled.

test_cases.title: End condition with 'OR' logic (any sub-condition fulfilled)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive trackside text messages. A trackside text message is configured with two end sub-conditions (EC1, EC2) and the trackside definition specifies that the end condition is fulfilled if 'any' of them are fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with end sub-conditions EC1 and EC2, logic 'OR'.
test_cases.assumptions: EC1 and EC2 are valid sub-conditions defined in SUBSET-026 §3.12.3.4.3.

steps.action: Set EC1 to fulfilled and EC2 to not fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the end condition fulfilled.

steps.action: Set EC1 to not fulfilled and EC2 to fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the end condition fulfilled.

steps.action: Set both EC1 and EC2 to fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the end condition fulfilled.

test_cases.title: End condition with 'AND' logic (all sub-conditions fulfilled)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive trackside text messages. A trackside text message is configured with two end sub-conditions (EC1, EC2) and the trackside definition specifies that the end condition is fulfilled if 'all' of them are fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with end sub-conditions EC1 and EC2, logic 'AND'.
test_cases.assumptions: EC1 and EC2 are valid sub-conditions defined in SUBSET-026 §3.12.3.4.3.

steps.action: Set EC1 to fulfilled and EC2 to not fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU does not consider the end condition fulfilled.

steps.action: Set EC1 to not fulfilled and EC2 to fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU does not consider the end condition fulfilled.

steps.action: Set both EC1 and EC2 to fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the end condition fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Consistent logic application for start and end conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive trackside text messages. A trackside text message is configured with two start sub-conditions (SC1, SC2) and two end sub-conditions (EC1, EC2). The trackside definition specifies that the logic is 'OR' for both start and end conditions.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with start sub-conditions SC1, SC2 and end sub-conditions EC1, EC2, logic 'OR' for both.
test_cases.assumptions: SC1, SC2, EC1, EC2 are valid sub-conditions.

steps.action: Set SC1 to fulfilled, SC2 to not fulfilled, EC1 to not fulfilled, EC2 to not fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition fulfilled and the end condition not fulfilled.

steps.action: Set SC1 to not fulfilled, SC2 to not fulfilled, EC1 to fulfilled, EC2 to not fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition not fulfilled and the end condition fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled immediately when no start sub-conditions are defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and process trackside text messages. A trackside text message is configured with no start sub-conditions defined (i.e., none of the conditions listed in SUBSET-026 §3.12.3.4.2 are present).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside text message with empty start condition field.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's internal state allows for the immediate evaluation of start conditions upon message reception.

steps.action: Transmit a trackside text message to the OBU where the start condition field is empty or contains no valid start sub-conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and processes it.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's internal state or log regarding the start condition of the received message.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as fulfilled immediately, without waiting for any external event or time delay.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display immediately (Mode 1)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages. A text message is configured to require driver confirmation where acknowledgement ends the display regardless of other conditions.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with 'acknowledgement ends display' flag set.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific text message content and duration are not critical, only the acknowledgement logic is tested.

steps.action: Send a text message to the OBU that requests driver confirmation and is defined such that acknowledgement ends the display.
steps.expected: The text message is displayed on the OBU screen.

steps.action: Press the driver acknowledgement button on the OBU.
steps.expected: The text message display ends immediately.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement is a necessary condition but not sufficient (Mode 2)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages. A text message is configured to require driver confirmation where acknowledgement is a necessary condition in addition to the standard end condition (e.g., timer expiry).
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with 'acknowledgement required' flag set, with a defined display duration (e.g., 10 seconds).
test_cases.assumptions: The standard end condition is a timer of 10 seconds.

steps.action: Send a text message to the OBU that requests driver confirmation and is defined such that acknowledgement is a necessary condition for ending the display in addition to the timer.
steps.expected: The text message is displayed on the OBU screen.

steps.action: Press the driver acknowledgement button on the OBU before the timer expires.
steps.expected: The text message display continues; it does not end immediately.

steps.action: Wait for the timer to expire.
steps.expected: The text message display ends.

test_cases.title: Display ends without acknowledgement when not required (Mode 2)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages. A text message is configured to require driver confirmation where acknowledgement is a necessary condition in addition to the standard end condition.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with 'acknowledgement required' flag set, with a defined display duration (e.g., 10 seconds).
test_cases.assumptions: The standard end condition is a timer of 10 seconds.

steps.action: Send a text message to the OBU that requests driver confirmation and is defined such that acknowledgement is a necessary condition for ending the display in addition to the timer.
steps.expected: The text message is displayed on the OBU screen.

steps.action: Do not press the driver acknowledgement button and wait for the timer to expire.
steps.expected: The text message display ends when the timer expires, even without acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: End condition already fulfilled at start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where a text message can be triggered. The end condition for the specific text message is already fulfilled before the start condition is met.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger the start condition of the text message.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific text message has a defined start and end condition that can be independently set or observed in the test environment.

steps.action: Ensure the end condition of the text message is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The end condition status is active/fulfilled.

steps.action: Trigger the start condition of the text message.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end condition immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU display.
steps.expected: The text message is not displayed at all.

test_cases.title: End condition already fulfilled with driver confirmation requested
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where a text message requiring driver confirmation can be triggered. The end condition for the specific text message is already fulfilled before the start condition is met.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger the start condition of the text message that requires driver confirmation.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific text message is configured to require driver confirmation.

steps.action: Ensure the end condition of the text message is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The end condition status is active/fulfilled.

steps.action: Trigger the start condition of the text message.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end condition immediately.

steps.action: Observe the OBU display and driver interface.
steps.expected: The text message is not displayed and no driver confirmation prompt is shown.

test_cases.title: Text message length measurement with location end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where text messages can be displayed. A text message is configured with a start condition containing a location sub-condition and an end condition containing a location sub-condition.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message configuration: Start Location = L1, End Location = L2. Train moves from L1 to L2.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a mechanism to observe or log the calculated display length or the start/end points of the display window.

steps.action: Configure a text message with a start condition using location L1 and an end condition using location L2.
steps.expected: Configuration is accepted by the OBU.

steps.action: Move the train to location L1 to trigger the start condition.
steps.expected: The text message display starts. The OBU records the start location as L1.

steps.action: Move the train to location L2 to trigger the end condition.
steps.expected: The text message display ends. The OBU calculates the display length as the distance between L1 and L2.

steps.action: Verify the measured display length.
steps.expected: The measured length corresponds exactly to the distance from L1 to L2, ignoring any other potential start sub-conditions.

test_cases.title: Text message length measurement with multiple start sub-conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where text messages can be displayed. A text message is configured with a start condition containing both a location sub-condition (L1) and another sub-condition (e.g., speed or time), and an end condition containing a location sub-condition (L2).
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message configuration: Start Condition = {Location: L1, Speed: >0 km/h}, End Condition = {Location: L2}. Train moves from L1 to L2 with speed > 0 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a mechanism to observe or log the calculated display length or the start/end points of the display window.

steps.action: Configure a text message with a start condition including location L1 and speed > 0 km/h, and an end condition including location L2.
steps.expected: Configuration is accepted by the OBU.

steps.action: Move the train to location L1 while maintaining speed > 0 km/h to trigger the start condition.
steps.expected: The text message display starts. The OBU uses location L1 as the reference point for length measurement.

steps.action: Move the train to location L2 to trigger the end condition.
steps.expected: The text message display ends. The OBU calculates the display length based on the distance from L1 to L2.

steps.action: Verify the measured display length.
steps.expected: The measured length is the distance from L1 to L2, confirming that the location sub-condition in the start condition is used for measurement regardless of the speed sub-condition.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report transmission upon acknowledgment
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages. A text message requesting a driver acknowledgement report has been received from the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message ID: 0x1234, RBC ID: RBC-01, Driver Acknowledgement Request: True
test_cases.assumptions: The communication link between OBU and RBC is active and functional.

steps.action: Display the text message on the driver interface.
steps.expected: The text message is visible to the driver.

steps.action: The driver presses the acknowledgement button on the driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the acknowledgement input.

steps.action: Monitor the communication channel to the RBC.
steps.expected: A driver acknowledgement report is sent to RBC-01.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent driver acknowledgement report.
steps.expected: The report contains the text message identifier 0x1234.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report with specific message identifier
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is connected to the RBC. A text message with a unique identifier is pending acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text Message ID: 0xABCD, RBC ID: RBC-02

steps.action: Receive a text message with ID 0xABCD from RBC-02 that requests a driver acknowledgement report.
steps.expected: The message is stored and displayed.

steps.action: The driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the report transmission.

steps.action: Capture the transmitted report.

test_cases.title: Reject duplicate unacknowledged text message
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where it can receive text messages. A text message with identifier ID_A requesting driver acknowledgement has been received and is currently unacknowledged.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new text message with identifier ID_A requesting driver acknowledgement.

steps.action: Send a new text message to the OBU with identifier ID_A requesting driver acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the newly received text message.

test_cases.title: Accept new text message after previous one is acknowledged
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received a text message with identifier ID_A requesting driver acknowledgement. The driver has acknowledged this message.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new text message with identifier ID_A requesting driver acknowledgement.

steps.action: Send a new text message to the OBU with identifier ID_A requesting driver acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the newly received text message.

test_cases.title: Accept text message with different identifier while previous is unacknowledged
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received a text message with identifier ID_A requesting driver acknowledgement. This message is currently unacknowledged.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new text message with identifier ID_B (where ID_B != ID_A) requesting driver acknowledgement.

steps.action: Send a new text message to the OBU with identifier ID_B requesting driver acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the newly received text message.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile OS/LS Mode Profile'ın referans noktası ötesinde silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir Mode Profile (OS/LS) içeren geçerli bir MA ile çalışmaktadır. Infill MA, referans konumu (infill reference location) mevcut Mode Profile'ın başlangıcından ötede (önünde) olacak şekilde hazırlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA: Referans konumu, mevcut OS/LS Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasından ötededir. Infill MA'da yeni bir Mode Profile listesi ve SH balise group listesi mevcuttur.
test_cases.assumptions: Infill referans konumu, mevcut Mode Profile'ın bitiş noktasından önce veya eşittir, böylece silme işlemi kısmi veya tam olabilir.

steps.action: OBU'ya hazırlanan Infill MA verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen Mode Profile'ı tamamen silmez. Sadece infill referans konumundan öteye (önüne) gelen OS/LS Mode Profile kısımlarını siler.

steps.action: OBU'nun aktif Mode Profile durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Infill referans konumundan önceki (arka taraftaki) Mode Profile kısımları korunur ve aktif kalır. Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile listesi ve SH balise group listesi yok sayılır (yok sayılma durumu gözlemlenir).

test_cases.title: Infill referansı izlenen SH Mode Profile başlangıcında veya arkasında ise silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir SH (Supervised) Mode Profile içeren geçerli bir MA ile çalışmaktadır. Infill MA, referans konumu mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasıyla aynı veya arkasında (rear) olacak şekilde hazırlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA: Referans konumu, mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasına eşittir veya arkasındadır. Infill MA'da yeni bir Mode Profile listesi ve SH balise group listesi mevcuttur.

steps.action: OBU'ya hazırlanan Infill MA verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı siler.

steps.action: OBU'nun aktif Mode Profile durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Eski SH Mode Profile aktif değildir. Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile listesi ve SH balise group listesi yok sayılır.

test_cases.title: Infill referansı izlenen SH Mode Profile başlangıcından ötede ise korunması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir SH (Supervised) Mode Profile içeren geçerli bir MA ile çalışmaktadır. Infill MA, referans konumu mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasından ötede (önünde) olacak şekilde hazırlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA: Referans konumu, mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıç noktasından ötededir. Infill MA'da yeni bir Mode Profile listesi ve SH balise group listesi mevcuttur.

steps.action: OBU'ya hazırlanan Infill MA verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı silmez, korur.

steps.expected: Eski SH Mode Profile aktif kalmaya devam eder. Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile listesi ve SH balise group listesi yok sayılır.

test_cases.title: Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise listelerinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir Mode Profile ile çalışmaktadır. Infill MA, referans konumu mevcut Mode Profile'ın başlangıcından ötede olacak şekilde hazırlanmıştır. Infill MA, geçerli formatlarda yeni bir Mode Profile ve SH balise group listesi içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA: Referans konumu mevcut Mode Profile'ın başlangıcından ötededir. Infill MA'da geçerli formatlarda yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise group listesi mevcuttur.

steps.action: OBU'ya hazırlanan Infill MA verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise group listelerini işlemez ve yok sayar.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut Mode Profile ve SH balise group listesi durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Mevcut Mode Profile ve SH balise group listesi, Infill MA'daki yeni verilerden etkilenmeden korunur (referans konumuna göre silme kuralı dışında).

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında geçici EOA ve SvL (Release Speed yok) - Profil SvL gerektiriyor
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Mode Profile'a geçiş yapmamış durumdadır. Mode Profile başlangıç noktası tanımlıdır ve profil bu noktada bir SvL (Stop with Limit) gerektirmektedir. MA (Movement Authority) geçerlidir.

steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici bir EOA (End of Authority) olarak işler.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili davranışı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında geçici EOA ve SvL (Release Speed yok) - Profil SvL gerektirmiyor, MA'da LOA var (LOA profil başlangıcının ötesinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Mode Profile'a geçiş yapmamış durumdadır. Mode Profile başlangıç noktası tanımlıdır ve profil bu noktada SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA, LOA (Limit of Authority) içerir ve LOA konumu Mode Profile başlangıcının ötesindedir (veya eşittir).

test_cases.title: Mode Profile'a geçiş sonrası geçici EOA davranışının sonlanması

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with same identity

steps.action: MFA kodu girilmeden doğrudan girişe devam edilmeye çalışılır (veya MFA adımından atlanmaya çalışılır).
steps.expected: Sistem ikinci faktörü zorunlu tutar, kimlik doğrulama tamamlanmaz ve kullanıcı yetkili alana erişemez.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunun inaktivite zaman aşımında yeniden kimlik doğrulama istenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış bir oturumla VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi (ör. 15 dakika) bilinmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli AAL2 oturum kimliği.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi 15 dakika olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturumda herhangi bir işlem yapmadan inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin (15 dakika) dolmasını bekler.
steps.expected: Sistem, oturumu pasif olarak işaretler ve zaman aşımı süresinin dolduğunu içsel olarak kaydeder.

steps.action: Zaman aşımı süresinden sonra kullanıcı, sistemde bir işlem (ör. sayfa yenileme veya buton tıklama) yapar.
steps.expected: Sistem, kullanıcıyı yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranına yönlendirir ve mevcut oturumun AAL2 seviyesinde yeniden doğrulanmasını ister.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, AAL2 gereksinimlerini karşılayan kimlik doğrulama bilgilerini (ör. şifre + OTP) girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimlik doğrulamayı başarıyla tamamlar ve kullanıcıyı önceki oturum durumuna geri döndürür.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunun genel zaman aşımında oturumun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış bir oturumla VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan genel oturum zaman aşımı süresi (ör. 8 saat) bilinmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli AAL2 oturum kimliği.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te genel oturum zaman aşımı süresi 8 saat olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturumda aktif kalarak (inaktivite zaman aşımını tetiklemeyecek şekilde) genel zaman aşımı süresinin (8 saat) dolmasını bekler.
steps.expected: Sistem, genel zaman aşımı süresinin dolduğunu tespit eder.

steps.action: Zaman aşımı süresinden sonra kullanıcı, sistemde bir işlem yapar.
steps.expected: Sistem, oturumu sonlandırır ve kullanıcıyı giriş ekranına yönlendirir. Yeniden kimlik doğrulama istenir.

test_cases.title: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama sırasında başarısız denemelerin işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış bir oturumla VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. Inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi dolmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçersiz AAL2 kimlik doğrulama bilgileri.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi 15 dakika olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinden sonra kullanıcı, sistemde bir işlem yapar.
steps.expected: Sistem, yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranını gösterir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, geçersiz AAL2 kimlik doğrulama bilgilerini girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimlik doğrulamayı reddeder ve hata mesajı gösterir. Oturum, yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında kalır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, tekrar geçersiz AAL2 kimlik doğrulama bilgilerini girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, kimlik doğrulamayı reddeder ve hata mesajı gösterir. Oturum, yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranında kalır.

test_cases.title: Account recovery notification sent to representative
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is in a recoverable state.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification channel (e.g., email) is configured and monitored for the representative.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid credentials.
steps.expected: The recovery process completes successfully.

steps.action: Check the notification channel associated with the representative account.
steps.expected: A notification regarding the account recovery is received by the representative.

test_cases.title: Account recovery notification sent to designee
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a designated alternate contact (designee) configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The designee's notification channel is configured and monitored.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid credentials.
steps.expected: The recovery process completes successfully.

steps.action: Check the notification channel associated with the designee.
steps.expected: A notification regarding the account recovery is received by the designee.

test_cases.title: Electronic notification addresses receive account notifications
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with at least one registered email address and one registered postal address.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account ID: COMP-001, Registered Email: rep@company.com, Registered Postal: 123 Main St, City
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to send notifications via email for electronic addresses.

steps.action: Trigger an account notification event (e.g., password change or new login) for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system initiates the notification process for all registered addresses.

steps.action: Check the email inbox for the registered email address (rep@company.com).
steps.expected: An account notification email is received.

steps.action: Verify that no physical mail or postal notification was generated for the registered postal address.
steps.expected: No postal notification is sent to the registered postal address.

test_cases.title: Multiple electronic notification addresses all receive notifications
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with two or more registered email addresses and one postal address.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account ID: COMP-002, Registered Emails: rep1@company.com, rep2@company.com, Registered Postal: 456 Oak Ave, City

steps.action: Trigger an account notification event for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system initiates the notification process for all registered addresses.

steps.action: Check the email inbox for the first registered email address (rep1@company.com).
steps.expected: An account notification email is received.

steps.action: Check the email inbox for the second registered email address (rep2@company.com).
steps.expected: An account notification email is received.

steps.action: Verify that no physical mail or postal notification was generated for the registered postal address.
steps.expected: No postal notification is sent to the registered postal address.

test_cases.title: No notifications sent if only postal address is registered
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with only a registered postal address and no electronic notification addresses (e.g., email).
test_cases.test_inputs: Account ID: COMP-003, Registered Postal: 789 Pine Rd, City, Registered Emails: None
test_cases.assumptions: The system does not have a fallback mechanism to send electronic notifications if none are registered.

steps.action: Trigger an account notification event for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system initiates the notification process.

steps.action: Verify that no physical mail or postal notification was generated for the registered postal address.
steps.expected: No postal notification is sent to the registered postal address.

steps.action: Verify that no electronic notification was sent.
steps.expected: No electronic notification is sent as no electronic addresses are registered.

test_cases.title: E-Devlet oturum süresi dolmadan VBP oturumunun devam etmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı e-Devlet üzerinden VBP'ye başarıyla giriş yapmıştır. E-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi (ör. 10 dakika) VBP oturum süresinden (ör. 30 dakika) kısadır.
test_cases.assumptions: E-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi 10 dakika, VBP oturum süresi 30 dakika olarak yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı VBP'de bir işlem yapar ve e-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi dolana kadar bekler (10 dakika).
steps.expected: VBP oturumu aktif kalır, kullanıcı işlem yapmaya devam edebilir.

steps.action: E-Devlet assertion süresi dolduktan sonra (11. dakikada) kullanıcı VBP'de bir sayfa yeniler veya yeni bir işlem başlatır.
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla tamamlanır, kullanıcı oturumdan atılmaz.

steps.action: VBP oturum süresi dolana kadar (30. dakikaya kadar) kullanıcı VBP'de işlem yapmaya devam eder.
steps.expected: Oturum 30. dakikaya kadar kesintisiz devam eder.

test_cases.title: E-Devlet assertion süresi dolunca VBP oturumunun etkilenmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı e-Devlet üzerinden VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. E-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi 5 dakikadır.
test_cases.assumptions: E-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi 5 dakika olarak ayarlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı VBP'de oturum açar ve 5 dakika bekler.
steps.expected: E-Devlet assertion süresi dolmuş olur.

steps.action: 5. dakikadan hemen sonra (5:01) kullanıcı VBP'de bir form doldurur ve gönderir.
steps.expected: Form başarıyla gönderilir, oturum kesintiye uğramaz.

steps.action: Kullanıcı VBP'de oturumunu sonlandırana kadar veya VBP oturum süresi dolana kadar işlem yapar.
steps.expected: Oturum, e-Devlet assertion süresine bağlı kalmadan VBP'nin kendi oturum politikasına göre devam eder.

test_cases.title: E-Devlet assertion süresi dolmuş olsa bile VBP oturumunun geçerli kalması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı e-Devlet üzerinden VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. E-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi 1 dakikadır.
test_cases.assumptions: E-Devlet assertion geçerlilik süresi 1 dakika olarak ayarlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı VBP'de oturum açar ve 1 dakika bekler.
steps.expected: E-Devlet assertion süresi dolmuş olur.

steps.action: Kullanıcı VBP'de kritik bir işlem (ör. başvuru gönderimi) yapar.
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla tamamlanır, 'Oturum süreniz doldu' veya benzeri bir hata mesajı gösterilmez.

steps.action: Kullanıcı VBP oturumunu manuel olarak sonlandırır.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlanır, kullanıcı ana sayfaya yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: Federation transaction initiation includes VBP identifier and nonce
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured with a valid identifier for e-Devlet federation. A test user is authenticated in VBP.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user credentials for VBP.
test_cases.assumptions: Network traffic between VBP and e-Devlet can be intercepted and inspected for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate a federation transaction from VBP to e-Devlet.
steps.expected: VBP sends an assertion request to e-Devlet.

steps.action: Inspect the assertion request payload sent by VBP.
steps.expected: The request contains a field identifying VBP.

steps.action: Inspect the assertion request payload sent by VBP.
steps.expected: The request contains a cryptographic nonce value.

test_cases.title: Assertion request nonce is unique per transaction
test_cases.preconditions: VBP is configured for federation with e-Devlet.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user credentials for VBP.
test_cases.assumptions: Multiple federation transactions can be initiated in succession for testing.

steps.action: Initiate the first federation transaction and capture the nonce value from the assertion request.
steps.expected: A nonce value N1 is present in the request.

steps.action: Initiate a second federation transaction and capture the nonce value from the assertion request.
steps.expected: A nonce value N2 is present in the request.

steps.action: Compare N1 and N2.
steps.expected: N1 is not equal to N2, indicating a unique nonce for each transaction.

test_cases.title: VBP audience identifier'ı içeren e-Devlet assertion'ının kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet SSO ile entegre edilmiş ve test ortamında çalışmaktadır. VBP'nin e-Devlet'te kayıtlı Audience ID'si (ör. 'vbp-test-aud') bilinmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir e-Devlet oturumu ile oluşturulmuş, Audience alanı 'vbp-test-aud' içeren bir SAML assertion.
test_cases.assumptions: e-Devlet test ortamı, VBP'ye özel Audience ID'si içeren assertion üretebilmektedir.

steps.action: e-Devlet test ortamından, Audience alanı VBP'nin Audience ID'sini ('vbp-test-aud') içeren geçerli bir SAML assertion'ı VBP'ye gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP, assertion'ı doğrular ve kullanıcıyı kimlik doğrulaması yapılmış olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: VBP'nin oturum durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı oturumu aktif olarak başlatılır ve VBP arayüzüne erişim sağlanır.

test_cases.title: VBP audience identifier'ı içermeyen e-Devlet assertion'ının reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet SSO ile entegre edilmiş ve test ortamında çalışmaktadır. VBP'nin e-Devlet'te kayıtlı Audience ID'si 'vbp-test-aud' olarak tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir e-Devlet oturumu ile oluşturulmuş, Audience alanı başka bir RP için tanımlı bir ID'yi (ör. 'other-rp-aud') içeren bir SAML assertion.
test_cases.assumptions: e-Devlet test ortamı, farklı Audience ID'leri içeren assertion üretebilmektedir.

steps.action: e-Devlet test ortamından, Audience alanı VBP'nin Audience ID'sini içermeyen (ör. 'other-rp-aud') bir SAML assertion'ı VBP'ye gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP, assertion'ı reddeder ve kimlik doğrulama başarısız olarak işaretlenir.

steps.action: VBP'nin oturum durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı oturumu başlatılmaz ve kullanıcı kimlik doğrulama ekranına yönlendirilir veya hata mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Boş Audience alanı içeren e-Devlet assertion'ının reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet SSO ile entegre edilmiş ve test ortamında çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir e-Devlet oturumu ile oluşturulmuş, Audience alanı boş veya eksik olan bir SAML assertion.
test_cases.assumptions: e-Devlet test ortamı, Audience alanı boş olan assertion üretebilmektedir.

steps.action: e-Devlet test ortamından, Audience alanı boş olan bir SAML assertion'ı VBP'ye gönderilir.
steps.expected: VBP, assertion'ı reddeder ve kimlik doğrulama başarısız olarak işaretlenir.

steps.action: VBP'nin oturum durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı oturumu başlatılmaz ve kullanıcı kimlik doğrulama ekranına yönlendirilir veya hata mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Setting a new phone number triggers authenticator binding process
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system implements the NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2 binding process, which typically involves sending a one-time code to the new number and verifying it.

steps.action: Navigate to the profile settings and select the option to change the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The system initiates the authenticator binding process (e.g., prompts for a new number and sends a verification code to the new number).

steps.action: Enter the new telephone number and submit the request.
steps.expected: A one-time verification code is sent to the new telephone number.

steps.action: Enter the received verification code into the system.
steps.expected: The system validates the code and successfully binds the new telephone number as the authenticator.

steps.action: Check the account profile details.
steps.expected: The pre-registered telephone number is updated to the new number.

test_cases.title: Changing phone number without verification code fails
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: New valid telephone number, incorrect verification code.
test_cases.assumptions: The binding process requires a valid one-time code sent to the new number to complete.

steps.action: Initiate the change of the pre-registered telephone number and enter a new number.
steps.expected: The system sends a verification code to the new number.

steps.action: Enter an incorrect verification code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code and displays an error message. The telephone number is not changed.

steps.action: Check the account profile details.
steps.expected: The pre-registered telephone number remains the original number.

test_cases.title: Attempting to change phone number via direct API call without binding process
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: Direct API request to update phone number field.
test_cases.assumptions: The system exposes an API endpoint for profile updates that should be protected by the binding process logic.

steps.action: Send a direct API request to update the telephone number field without initiating the authenticator binding process (e.g., without providing a verification code token).
steps.expected: The system rejects the request with an error indicating that the authenticator binding process is required.

steps.action: Check the account profile details via a valid read request.
steps.expected: The pre-registered telephone number remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Binding a second authenticator to an account with one existing authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with one active authenticator bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for a new authenticator (e.g., new phone number or security key).
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports at least two authenticators per account as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using the existing authenticator.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the account settings page.

steps.action: Navigate to the authenticator management section and initiate the binding of a new authenticator.
steps.expected: The system displays the interface to register a new authenticator.

steps.action: Provide the details for the new authenticator and complete the verification process.
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding of the new authenticator.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators.
steps.expected: Both the original and the newly added authenticator are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Binding a third authenticator to an account with two existing authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with two active authenticators bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the account, details for a third new authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows more than two authenticators per account.

steps.action: Log in to the company representative account using one of the existing authenticators.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Initiate the binding of a third authenticator.
steps.expected: The system allows the addition of a new authenticator.

steps.action: Complete the registration and verification of the third authenticator.
steps.expected: The system confirms the successful binding.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators.
steps.expected: All three authenticators are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Attempting to bind an authenticator that is already bound to another account
test_cases.preconditions: Two distinct company representative accounts exist. Account A has no authenticators. Account B has one authenticator (e.g., phone number X).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for Account A, details for the authenticator already bound to Account B (phone number X).
test_cases.assumptions: A single authenticator (e.g., phone number) cannot be bound to multiple accounts simultaneously.

steps.action: Log in to Account A.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Attempt to bind the authenticator (phone number X) that is already bound to Account B.
steps.expected: The system rejects the binding request and displays an error message indicating the authenticator is already in use.

steps.action: View the list of bound authenticators for Account A.
steps.expected: No new authenticator is added to Account A.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when account max is lower than authenticator max
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 2. A new authenticator capable of AAL 3 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 2, New Authenticator with max AAL 3
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL levels 1, 2, and 3 as per NIST SP 800-63B-4.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 2.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at lower AAL when authenticator max is lower than account max
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 3. A new authenticator capable of AAL 2 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 3, New Authenticator with max AAL 2
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports AAL levels 1, 2, and 3 as per NIST SP 800-63B-4.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 2.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication required at AAL 1 when both account and authenticator support only AAL 1
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 1. A new authenticator capable of AAL 1 is ready to be bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 1, New Authenticator with max AAL 1
test_cases.assumptions: AAL 1 is the minimum supported level.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 1.
steps.expected: The authentication is accepted, and the new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

test_cases.title: Authentication failure when provided AAL is lower than required
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a maximum available AAL of 2. A new authenticator capable of AAL 3 is ready to be bound. The required AAL is 2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Account with max AAL 2, New Authenticator with max AAL 3, Authentication attempt at AAL 1
test_cases.assumptions: The system can distinguish between AAL 1 and AAL 2 authentication attempts.

steps.action: Initiate the process to bind the new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication.

steps.action: Provide authentication credentials corresponding to AAL 1.
steps.expected: The authentication is rejected, and an error message indicating insufficient authentication level is displayed.

test_cases.title: Bağımsız bildirim mekanizması ile doğrulayıcı ekleme bildirimi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı aktif ve oturum açılmış durumdadır. Hesaba henüz eklenmemiş yeni bir doğrulayıcı (ör. SMS, e-posta veya TOTP) bilgisi hazırlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni doğrulayıcı türü ve ilgili iletişim bilgisi (örn. telefon numarası veya e-posta adresi).
test_cases.assumptions: Bildirim mekanizması (örn. SMS veya e-posta) test ortamında çalışır durumda ve bağımsız bir kanaldır (doğrulayıcı ile aynı kanal değildir).

steps.action: Şirket temsilcisi hesabına yeni bir doğrulayıcı eklenir.
steps.expected: Sistem, doğrulayıcı ekleme işlemini başlatır ve bağımsız bildirim mekanizması üzerinden bir bildirim gönderir.

steps.action: Bağımsız bildirim kanalından (örn. SMS veya e-posta) gelen bildirim kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Bildirim, yeni doğrulayıcının bağlandığına dair içerik taşır ve NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1 gereksinimlerine uygun olarak bağımsız bir kanaldan ulaştığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Doğrulayıcı ekleme sırasında bildirim kanalının bağımsızlığı kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı aktif. Eklenecek doğrulayıcı türü, bildirim kanalından farklı bir teknoloji kullanmaktadır (örn. doğrulayıcı TOTP ise bildirim SMS veya e-posta olmalı).
test_cases.test_inputs: Farklı kanalları kullanan doğrulayıcı ve bildirim kombinasyonu.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1'e uygun olarak bildirim kanalının doğrulayıcı kanalından bağımsız olmasını zorunlu kılmaktadır.

steps.action: Doğrulayıcı olarak TOTP uygulaması, bildirim kanalı olarak SMS seçilerek doğrulayıcı ekleme işlemi yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, işlemi kabul eder ve SMS kanalı üzerinden bildirim gönderir.
